apis.description: AWS Rekognition is Amazon's managed computer vision service for detecting objects, faces, text, unsafe content, and custom labels in images and videos. Developers call region-specific HTTPS endpoints with SigV4-signed requests to run analysis jobs, face comparison, and content moderation without training models. It integrates with S3, IAM, and other AWS services for production media pipelines.

auth.details: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) with IAM access key ID and secret access key (or temporary STS credentials). No simple API key header; requests must be signed per AWS protocol.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 12-mo Free Tier: 1,000 images/mo each Group 1 & Group 2 Image APIs (not Image Properties); 1,000 face + 1,000 user vector objects/mo; Video 60 min/mo. Custom Labels: 2 training + 1 inference hr/mo. Face Liveness: no free tier listed. Post-2025-07-15 new accounts: up to $200 AWS Free Tier credits may apply.

apis.rate_limits: AWS publishes default service quotas (TPS) per API/region in Rekognition quotas docs and Service Quotas console; e.g. many image APIs default ~5 TPS (varies by API/region); limits are soft and increase-requestable
use_cases: detect objects and scenes in an image
moderate user-uploaded photos for unsafe content
compare two face images for identity match
extract text (OCR) from images and screenshots
index faces for search in a collection

apis.name: Azure AI Translator
apis.tagline: Cloud translation for text and documents across 100+ languages
apis.description: Microsoft Azure AI Translator provides neural machine translation for text, documents, and custom models. It supports 100+ languages with features like language detection, transliteration, dictionary lookup, and custom translation via Custom Translator. Developers call regional or global endpoints with subscription keys or Microsoft Entra ID.

auth.details: Subscription key via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header (or Authorization Bearer for Entra ID); region via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region for multi-service resources

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free (F0): 2 million characters/month
pricing.paid_plans: Standard S1 pay-as-you-go by character volume; commitment tiers and custom models available

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.request: curl -X POST "https://api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com/translate?api-version=3.0&to=es" -H "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region: YOUR_REGION" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '[{"Text":"Hello, world!"}]'

use_cases: translate user-generated text between languages
detect language of incoming messages
batch-translate localization strings for an app
translate uploaded documents (PDF, DOCX)
transliterate text between scripts
look up dictionary translations for a word

apis.name: Azure AI Vision
apis.tagline: Cloud image analysis, OCR, and spatial analysis via Azure Cognitive Services
apis.description: Azure AI Vision (Computer Vision) provides REST APIs for image analysis, optical character recognition (OCR/Read), object detection, image tagging, and related vision capabilities. Developers call a regional Cognitive Services resource endpoint with a subscription key or Microsoft Entra token. Face-related features may require separate Face API access; product branding has consolidated under Azure AI Vision / Azure AI Services.

auth.details: Subscription key via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header (or query key), or Microsoft Entra ID bearer token; create a Vision/Cognitive Services resource in Azure Portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: F0: 5,000 free Image Analysis transactions per month, capped at 20 transactions per minute.

apis.rate_limits: Image Analysis: F0 allows 20 transactions/minute; S1 allows up to 20 transactions/second. Higher TPS may be requested through Azure support.
use_cases: extract text from images or PDFs with OCR
generate image captions and tags for accessibility
detect objects and brands in product photos
analyze image color and adult content flags
read handwritten or printed documents at scale

apis.name: Azure DevOps REST API
apis.tagline: Microsoft DevOps platform API for repos, pipelines, boards, artifacts, and work items
apis.description: Microsoft’s Azure DevOps REST API provides programmatic access to Azure DevOps Services (cloud) and Azure DevOps Server (on-prem). Developers can manage Git repositories, CI/CD pipelines, work items, boards, test plans, artifacts, and organization settings. Authentication typically uses personal access tokens (PATs), OAuth 2.0, or Microsoft Entra ID. API versioning is query-parameter based (api-version).

auth.details: Personal Access Token (PAT) via HTTP Basic (username empty or arbitrary, password=PAT) or Bearer token; also OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft Entra ID. Header: Authorization: Basic BASE64(:PAT) or Authorization: Bearer TOKEN

pricing.free_tier_limits: Azure DevOps Services free tier: first 5 users free; free Basic plan includes unlimited private Git repos, work item tracking, and 1,800 minutes of Microsoft-hosted CI/CD per month for open source / limited for private; API usage is not separately metered by request count in public docs — tied to Azure DevOps service plan
pricing.paid_plans: Basic plan ~$6/user/month after free users; Basic + Test Plans and other add-ons available; enterprise via Microsoft

apis.rate_limits: not published as a simple global RPS; Azure DevOps enforces per-organization/resource throttling (HTTP 429) with Retry-After; exact numeric limits vary and are not fully published for all resources
use_cases: list Azure DevOps projects in an organization
create or update work items and query boards
trigger or inspect CI/CD pipeline runs
clone/list Git repositories and pull requests
download build artifacts or package feeds
manage team members and permissions

apis.name: Azure IoT Hub
apis.tagline: Microsoft cloud hub for device management, twins, and bi-directional messaging.
apis.description: Azure IoT Hub is Microsoft's managed service for connecting, monitoring, and managing IoT devices at scale. It provides device identity, twin state, direct methods, cloud-to-device and device-to-cloud messaging, plus service APIs for jobs and bulk operations. Developers use REST (and SDKs) against a per-hub hostname under Azure Active Directory or shared access signatures.

auth.details: Shared Access Signature (SAS) tokens via Authorization header, or Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID) bearer tokens; connection strings from hub Access Control.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free (F1): 8,000 messages/day, metered in 0.5 KB blocks, and up to 500 registered device identities; limited to one free-tier hub per Azure subscription.

apis.rate_limits: Published throttles vary by operation and SKU. Identity-registry operations: 100/min/unit on Free/B1/S1/B2/S2 and 5,000/min/unit on B3/S3. Queries: 20/min/unit on Free/B1/S1/B2/S2 and 1,000/min/unit on B3/S3. Sustained excess can return HTTP 429.
use_cases: list registered IoT devices on a hub
read or update a device twin desired/reported properties
send a cloud-to-device message to a device
invoke a direct method on a connected device
create a job to update many device twins
query devices by twin properties

apis.name: Azure Maps
apis.tagline: Microsoft cloud geospatial platform for maps, search, routing, and location services
apis.description: Azure Maps provides REST APIs for interactive maps, geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, traffic, weather, and spatial analytics. Developers authenticate with a subscription key or Microsoft Entra ID and call atlas.microsoft.com endpoints for location-aware applications.

auth.details: Subscription key via subscription-key query param or subscription-key header; also Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) OAuth2 bearer tokens for managed identity/app registration

pricing.free_tier_limits: Gen2 free monthly allotments by service (e.g. 5,000 Render Tile transactions; other services have separate free quantities — see Azure Maps pricing).

apis.rate_limits: Per-service QPS limits published (e.g. Search ~500 QPS, Routing ~50 QPS, Render ~500 QPS; see Azure Maps QPS rate limits).
use_cases: geocode an address to coordinates
reverse geocode lat/lon to an address
get driving directions between two points
search nearby points of interest
display map tiles in a web or mobile app

apis.name: Azure OpenAI

pricing.free_tier_limits: no free tier
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go pricing per 1 million input/output tokens, varying by model and deployment type; provisioned throughput is priced separately through PTUs and reservations.

apis.rate_limits: Per-deployment TPM/RPM quotas vary by model and region; not a single global limit

moderate content with Azure OpenAI safety APIs

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access is free; usage constrained by published request weight / IP rate limits, not a paid API plan

apis.name: Birdeye

apis.description: Birdeye Data Services (BDS) is a production crypto market-intelligence API covering real-time and historical token prices, OHLCV, liquidity, trades, pairs, holders, wallets/PnL, trending discovery, and security across Solana, Sui, and major EVM chains. apis.rate_limits: Account-level (rps, with documented sustained rpm where listed): Standard 1 rps; Lite/Starter 15 rps; Premium 50 rps / 1000 rpm; Business 100 rps / 1500 rpm (higher Business tiers 150 rps per pricing); Growth AutoScale 150 rps / 9000 rpm; Enterprise custom. Wallet APIs (all packages, beta): 5 rps and 75 rpm. Some heavy endpoints have lower per-API caps.

fetch OHLCV candles for a token or trading pair
list or search tokens by liquidity, volume, or new listings
get wallet portfolio holdings and PnL on Solana
stream real-time price or trade updates via WebSocket (paid tiers)
pull top traders, holders, or gainer/loser leaderboards for a token

apis.name: Datadog API

apis.name: Datamuse
apis.tagline: Word-finding API for rhymes, synonyms, and constrained word search
apis.description: Datamuse is a free word-finding API for developers. auth.details: No API key required for typical use; requests are made as plain GET queries. Heavy or commercial use may require contacting the operator.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Up to 100,000 requests per day without a key until January 1, 2027; thereafter an API key is required with a 100,000-request daily limit per key.

apis.rate_limits: 100,000 requests/day; beyond that, requests may be rate-limited without notice. From January 1, 2027, an API key is required and the same daily limit applies per key.

look up synonyms or related words
constrained word search by spelling pattern
build crossword or word-game helpers
suggest similar-sounding words for writing tools

apis.name: DB-IP
apis.tagline: IP geolocation API and databases with free lite endpoint
apis.description: DB-IP provides IP geolocation lookup via a REST API and downloadable databases. Offers a free lite endpoint for non-commercial use plus paid commercial plans with higher accuracy and volume.

auth.details: API key via path or query parameter; self-serve signup

detect visitor country from IP

apis.name: DBpedia
apis.tagline: Wikipedia knowledge graph as structured Linked Data
apis.description: DBpedia extracts structured data from Wikipedia and exposes it as a large public knowledge graph via SPARQL and Linked Data endpoints. Developers query entities, relationships, and multilingual facts (people, places, works, concepts) without scraping Wikipedia, using standard RDF/SPARQL tooling for research, entity linking, and semantic applications.

auth.details: Public SPARQL and Linked Data endpoints; no API key or OAuth required for standard use.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 10,000-row result cap; 120s query execution limit; 50 parallel connections/IP; 100 req/s/IP with initial burst of 120

apis.rate_limits: 100 requests/second/IP with burst 120; 50 parallel connections/IP; 10,000 rows; 120-second query execution limit

example.request: curl -G 'https://dbpedia.org/sparql' --data-urlencode 'query=SELECT ?label WHERE { dbr:Berlin rdfs:label ?label . FILTER (lang(?label) = "en") } LIMIT 1' -H 'Accept: application/sparql-results+json'

use_cases: run SPARQL queries over Wikipedia-derived entities and relations
resolve a Wikipedia concept to a DBpedia URI and fetch RDF facts
look up multilingual labels and abstracts for a person, place, or work
entity-link free text mentions against the DBpedia knowledge graph
explore ontology types and properties for semantic data modeling

draw N cards from a deck and track remaining count
move drawn cards into named piles for hands or discard
reshuffle remaining cards mid-game without losing pile state
add jokers to a deck for games that need them
return cards from a pile back into the deck

Free keys still use https://api-free.deepl.com; paid use api.deepl.com. Paid plans are Growth (included chars + overage) and Enterprise.
pricing.paid_plans: DeepL API Growth is the current self-serve paid plan (fixed monthly/yearly price with included characters + usage overage). Enterprise API is custom via sales. DeepL API Pro is legacy and can no longer be purchased.

apis.rate_limits: not published

detect source language of input text
check API character usage and quota remaining
list supported source and target languages
translate uploaded documents (PDF, DOCX, etc.)

apis.name: Diffbot
apis.tagline: Structure the public web into a knowledge graph and extract entities from pages and text
apis.description: Diffbot turns unstructured web content into structured, linked knowledge. Core products: Extract (rule-free page classification and JSON extraction), Knowledge Graph Search/DQL and Enhance (query or enrich entities like people and organizations), Natural Language (entities, facts, sentiment from raw text), and Crawl/Bulk for site-scale jobs. Hosts differ by product: api.diffbot.com (Extract/Crawl), kg.diffbot.com (DQL/Enhance), nl.diffbot.com (NLP).

apis.rate_limits: By plan (pricing): Free 5 calls/min; Startup 5 calls/sec; Plus 25 calls/sec; Enterprise custom. Monthly credit/quota limits and product-specific free caps are separate from these rate limits; Plus Crawl job concurrency limits are not fully documented on the public pricing page.
use_cases: extract structured article or product JSON from any public page URL
query the Knowledge Graph with DQL for orgs/people matching filters
extract entities, facts, and relationships from raw text via NLP

apis.name: Discogs

There is no single multi-tenant public API host—each site exposes the same API at its own base URL.

auth.details: API key via HTTP headers: Api-Key and Api-Username (user the key acts as). Keys created in Admin → API. User API keys (for mobile/user apps) use different User-Api-Key headers.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Self-hosted open source: free (unlimited API on your instance). Hosted Discourse plans billed separately; API access included with site hosting—no published per-request free API tier.
pricing.paid_plans: Hosted: Free, Pro ($100/month), Business ($500/month), Enterprise (custom); pricing at discourse.org/pricing. Self-hosted is free open-source software. API/webhook access is included on Pro+ (and Free has limits per the plan grid).

apis.rate_limits: Per-site; default Discourse rate limits apply (e.g. admin can configure). Not a single global published number—depends on instance settings and user trust level.

apis.description: Public Free Dictionary API (dictionaryapi.dev) that returns word definitions, phonetics, part-of-speech entries, meanings, and origin data for English words. No authentication required; simple REST GET endpoints. Commonly used for language tools, learning apps, and NLP demos. Confirm current base URL, rate limits, and response shape from official docs before production use.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public free endpoints; no API key or signup needed for standard dictionary lookups.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: look up definitions and parts of speech for an English word
fetch phonetic transcription and pronunciation audio URL for a word
get word origin/etymology data when available
build a vocabulary or spelling helper for learning apps
resolve synonyms and related senses from dictionary entries

apis.name: FreeIPAPI
apis.tagline: No-key free IP geolocation for location, timezone, currency, and ISP
apis.description: FreeIPAPI is a free IP geolocation API that returns location, timezone, currency, and ISP details for a client IP or a queried address without requiring an API key for basic use.

auth.details: No authentication required for free endpoints; optional paid plans may use keys if offered.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 60 requests per minute

apis.rate_limits: Free plan: 60 requests per minute per frontend domain or backend public IP. Unlimited paid plan: unlimited backend requests; each frontend user remains limited to 60 requests per minute.
use_cases: geolocate a visitor IP
resolve timezone from IP
look up ISP for an IP
get currency for an IP location

apis.name: FreeToGame
apis.tagline: Free-to-play MMO and browser games catalog with platform and genre filters
apis.description: FreeToGame provides a public catalog API for free-to-play MMO, multiplayer, and browser games. Developers can list games, filter by platform (PC, browser, etc.) and genre, and fetch game details for discovery apps, recommendation tools, and game directories.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for personal and commercial use with linked attribution to FreeToGame; avoid exceeding 10 requests/second.

apis.rate_limits: Avoid more than 10 requests per second.
use_cases: list free-to-play games by platform
filter free MMOs by genre
get details for a free-to-play game by id
build a free-to-play game discovery directory
recommend browser-based multiplayer games

apis.name: FreshBooks API
apis.tagline: Invoicing, time tracking, and accounting API for freelancers and small service businesses.
apis.description: REST API for FreshBooks accounting software. Create and send invoices, track time and expenses, manage clients and projects, handle payments, and sync accounting data. OAuth2-based with bearer tokens. Popular with freelancers, agencies, and service businesses automating billing workflows.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Register an app at my.freshbooks.com/developers, obtain client_id and client_secret. Exchange code for access_token; call API with Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN. Also supports identity/me for account resolution.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No permanent free tier. FreshBooks offers a 30-day trial; continued API use requires a paid plan. No separate per-request API price is published.
pricing.paid_plans: Tied to FreshBooks subscription (Lite, Plus, Premium, Select). See freshbooks.com/pricing.

apis.rate_limits: No daily request cap. Short-window rate limiting applies when too many calls are made; thresholds are unspecified. List methods return at most 100 results per page.
use_cases: create and send an invoice to a client
list unpaid invoices for a business account
log billable time entries against a project
create or update a client contact
record an expense with category and amount
fetch account identity and business memberships

apis.name: Fuel Economy.gov
apis.tagline: EPA fuel economy ratings for US vehicles via free public API
apis.description: Public API from fueleconomy.gov providing EPA fuel economy ratings, vehicle specifications, MPG data, and emissions information for US vehicles. Free to use with no authentication required for standard endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required for public REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; no published request quota

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: look up EPA MPG for a vehicle year/make/model
list available model years for fuel economy data
get vehicle options by year and make
fetch detailed fuel economy specs by vehicle ID
compare emissions ratings across US vehicles

apis.name: FusionAuth
apis.tagline: Self-hostable authentication and authorization API for users, tenants, and MFA
apis.description: FusionAuth is a complete identity platform that provides a REST API for managing users, tenants, applications, roles, MFA, and OAuth/OpenID Connect. Available as self-hosted software or managed cloud. Developers integrate via HTTP APIs with API key authentication for admin operations and OAuth for end-user login flows.

auth.details: API key via Authorization header or X-FusionAuth-TenantId; exact format verified from official docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: create a user account
enable MFA for a user
list tenants
manage application roles

apis.name: GBIF
apis.tagline: Global biodiversity occurrence, species, and checklist data API
apis.description: GBIF (Global Biodiversity Information Facility) provides free open access to species occurrence records, taxonomic checklists, and related biodiversity data from museums, surveys, and citizen science worldwide. The REST API at api.gbif.org supports search and download of occurrences, species, datasets, and publishers for research, conservation, and applications.

auth.details: Most read endpoints are public with no auth. Authenticated downloads and registry write operations use basic auth with a free GBIF.org account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; no paid plans. Fair-use rate limiting applies.

apis.rate_limits: not published (fair use; heavy users should use bulk downloads)
use_cases: match a scientific or common name to a GBIF taxon key
search species occurrence records by taxon, country, or coordinates
look up taxonomy hierarchy for a species
list datasets or publishers contributing biodiversity data
download large occurrence datasets for offline analysis

apis.name: GDELT
apis.tagline: Global news monitoring APIs for full-text, geo, and TV coverage search
apis.description: The GDELT Project monitors worldwide broadcast, print, and web news and exposes free realtime JSON APIs (DOC, GEO, TV, Context) for full-text search, geographic mapping, television monitoring, and contextual snippets. Data is also available as bulk downloads and via Google BigQuery. No signup or API key is required for the public v2 APIs at api.gdeltproject.org.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoints accept query parameters only; no API key, OAuth, or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public APIs; no paid tier on api.gdeltproject.org. Soft limit typically treated as ~1 request per 5 seconds by community clients; no official free-tier quota page.

apis.rate_limits: Not formally published with hard numbers on official docs; community clients and GDELT MCP enforce ~1 request per 5 seconds. Exceeding may yield errors or throttling.
use_cases: search recent global news articles by keyword or phrase
chart news volume over time for a topic
map geographic mentions of a keyword in world news
analyze tone/sentiment distribution of media coverage
search TV news transcripts by network or market
pull contextual sentence snippets matching a query

apis.name: Gemini
apis.tagline: US-regulated crypto exchange REST and WebSocket APIs for market data and trading
apis.description: Gemini provides REST and WebSocket APIs for market data, order placement, account balances, and custody-related trading on its US-regulated cryptocurrency exchange. Public endpoints cover symbols, tickers, order books, and trades; private endpoints require API-key authentication for order management and account history.

auth.details: API key + secret via HMAC-SHA384 signed payload; X-GEMINI-APIKEY, X-GEMINI-PAYLOAD, X-GEMINI-SIGNATURE headers for private endpoints. Self-serve from account settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access free; trading fees apply per fee schedule
pricing.paid_plans: Trading fee tiers based on 30-day volume; API itself not sold as a paid product

apis.rate_limits: Public REST: 120 requests/minute (recommended ≤1 request/second). Private REST: 600 requests/minute (recommended ≤5 requests/second). Some endpoints have stricter documented limits.
use_cases: get BTC/USD ticker price and 24h volume
fetch order book depth for a trading pair
place and cancel limit orders on Gemini
stream live trades over WebSocket
list account balances and trade history
get recent public trade prints for a symbol

apis.name: Geoapify
apis.tagline: Geocoding, places, routing, and map tiles for location-aware apps
apis.description: Geoapify provides a suite of location APIs including geocoding, reverse geocoding, places search, routing, isochrones, map matching, and static/vector map tiles. Developers use an API key for authentication and can start on a free tier with higher paid plans for production volume.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter or Authorization header; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.response_snippet: {"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","properties":{"formatted":"38 Upper Montagu Street, London, W1H 1LJ, United Kingdom","lat":51.52022,"lon":-0.16206},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-0.16206,51.52022]}}]}

use_cases: geocode an address to coordinates
reverse geocode lat/lon to an address
search nearby places by category
calculate driving routes between points
generate static map images for locations

apis.name: GeoJS
apis.tagline: Free IP geolocation and country lookup for browsers and CDNs
apis.description: GeoJS is a lightweight, free IP geolocation service that returns country and location data as JSON or JSONP. Designed for browser and CDN use without API keys, it is popular for simple client-side geo lookups and content localization.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: look up country and city for a visitor IP
detect client country in the browser without an API key
localize content or currency by IP geolocation
enrich server logs with geo metadata for an IP

apis.name: GeoNames
apis.tagline: Global place-name and geospatial web services for cities, elevations, and postal codes
apis.description: GeoNames provides free and commercial web services for geographic data: place search, reverse geocoding, postal codes, elevations, timezone lookup, and more, backed by a large open gazetteer of places worldwide.

auth.details: Username query parameter (username=YOUR_USERNAME); free GeoNames account required; enable free web services on the account page. No separate API key is issued.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1000 credits/hour and 10000 credits/day (most requests = 1 credit)
pricing.paid_plans: Premium Web Services: Best Availability (from 250€/yr) and Best Price (from 40€/yr); credit packs valid 1 year. Details: https://www.geonames.org/commercial-webservices.html

apis.rate_limits: Free: 1000 credits/hour and 10000 credits/day; commercial Premium plans have higher published limits
use_cases: search places by name
reverse geocode coordinates to place names
look up timezone for a location
get elevation for coordinates
find postal codes for a place

apis.name: Giant Bomb
apis.tagline: Game wiki API for games, reviews, videos, characters, and franchises
apis.description: Giant Bomb provides a long-running game wiki REST API covering games, platforms, characters, franchises, companies, reviews, videos, and related metadata. Developers can search and fetch structured encyclopedia data for game catalogs, wiki-style apps, and media integrations using API-key authentication and JSON (or XML/JSONP) responses.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (or X-GiantBomb-Api-Key / Authorization: Bearer). Free self-serve key from giantbomb.com/api after login. Required User-Agent header.

use_cases: look up a game by Giant Bomb ID with platforms and summary
search games by name for catalog or autocomplete
list characters or franchises related to a game
fetch Giant Bomb reviews or video metadata for a title
get company or platform encyclopedia data for a game database

apis.name: GIPHY
apis.tagline: Industry-standard GIF search, trending, and stickers API for apps
apis.description: GIPHY provides a REST API for searching, browsing trending content, and retrieving GIFs and stickers. Developers use an API key with self-serve signup; free and paid tiers are available for production apps.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter; self-serve signup at developers.giphy.com dashboard

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 API calls per hour for beta keys; production access requires approval and paid custom pricing.

apis.rate_limits: Beta keys: 100 API calls/hour; production limits are assigned through an approved production key.
use_cases: search GIFs by keyword for chat or messaging features
fetch trending GIFs for a discovery feed
get a random GIF for a reaction or placeholder
search stickers for emoji-style reactions
translate text into a relevant GIF

apis.name: Gitea API
apis.tagline: GitHub-compatible REST API for self-hosted Git forge management
apis.description: Gitea is a lightweight, self-hostable Git forge written in Go. Its REST API (OpenAPI-documented) covers repositories, issues, pull requests, organizations, users, and more—providing a GitHub-like surface without vendor lock-in. Hosted instances (e.g. gitea.com) and self-hosted servers both expose the same API under /api/v1.

auth.details: Personal access token via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY header, or query param ?token=. Create tokens in user Settings > Applications. Basic auth and OAuth2 also supported.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Self-hosted: unlimited free (open source). gitea.com hosted: free public accounts; paid plans for private/org features—exact hosted quotas not centrally published as API rate cards.
pricing.paid_plans: Self-hosted is free (MIT). Commercial support and hosted plans via Gitea Ltd / Cloudron / third parties; check gitea.com and company site for current hosted pricing.

apis.rate_limits: No fixed requests-per-minute/hour default is documented for the current Gitea API. Self-hosted operators may impose deployment-level controls; built-in QoS overload protection is separate and disabled by default. gitea.com's service-specific quota is not publicly documented.
use_cases: list repositories for a user or organization
create or update issues and pull requests
manage org teams and repo collaborators
clone/push automation via repo metadata and deploy keys
search users, repos, and issues on a Gitea instance
mirror or sync repo settings across self-hosted forges

apis.name: Gitee Open API
apis.tagline: China-focused Git hosting REST API for repos, issues, PRs, and enterprises
apis.description: Gitee Open API (v5) is the public REST interface for Gitee, a major China-focused Git hosting platform. It covers repositories, issues, pull requests, users, organizations, and enterprise features as a regional alternative to GitHub. Developers authenticate primarily with OAuth2 or personal access tokens and call HTTPS endpoints under gitee.com/api/v5.

auth.details: OAuth2 access tokens or personal access tokens (private_token query param or Authorization: token header); self-serve app registration at gitee.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list a user's public repositories on Gitee
create or update an issue on a Gitee repo
fetch pull request details and comments
search or list enterprise organization members
get file contents or commit history for a repo

apis.name: GitHub REST API
apis.tagline: Programmatic access to repositories, issues, PRs, users, and GitHub platform data.
apis.description: Official REST API for GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise. Authenticate with personal access tokens, GitHub Apps, or OAuth; list and manage repos, issues, pull requests, workflows, users, orgs, and more. Responses are JSON over HTTPS at api.github.com with documented rate limits and media types.

auth.details: Bearer token via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN (classic/fine-grained PAT, GitHub App installation token, or OAuth access token). Unauthenticated requests allowed with very low rate limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with free GitHub accounts; primary cost is rate limits (see rate_limits), not per-request fees
pricing.paid_plans: Paid GitHub plans (Pro, Team, Enterprise) raise some product limits; API itself has no separate per-call pricing on github.com

apis.rate_limits: Authenticated (PAT/OAuth/App user-to-server): 5,000 req/hour primary (15,000 if via GHEC-owned app on your behalf). GitHub App installation: 5,000 req/hour minimum; non-Enterprise Cloud installations scale with repos/users (max 12,500/hour); Enterprise Cloud org installations: 15,000 req/hour. Unauthenticated: 60 req/hour per IP. Secondary limits and GraphQL point costs also apply.
use_cases: list open issues or PRs on a repository
get repository metadata, stars, and default branch
create or update an issue comment from an automation
fetch a user's public profile and repositories
check workflow run status for a CI integration
search code or repositories across GitHub

apis.name: GitLab API
apis.tagline: REST and GraphQL API for GitLab projects, issues, CI/CD, and repositories.
apis.description: GitLab provides a comprehensive REST API (v4) and GraphQL API for managing projects, repositories, issues, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, users, and more. Available on GitLab.com (SaaS) and self-managed instances. Supports personal access tokens, OAuth 2.0, and project/group access tokens for authentication.

auth.details: Personal/project/group access token via PRIVATE-TOKEN header or Authorization: Bearer. OAuth 2.0 also supported. Self-serve signup on GitLab.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: GitLab.com Free plan includes API access; rate limits apply (see rate_limits). Paid tiers (Premium, Ultimate) add features, not separate API pricing.
pricing.paid_plans: Free, Premium, Ultimate (per-user/seat pricing for Premium/Ultimate); self-managed has separate licensing.

apis.rate_limits: GitLab.com enforces rate limits; exact numbers vary by endpoint and plan — check docs for current unauthenticated/authenticated limits.
use_cases: list projects the authenticated user belongs to
create or update issues on a GitLab project
trigger or inspect CI/CD pipelines
read merge request status and comments
clone or inspect repository file contents via API
manage project members and access tokens

apis.name: Gladia
apis.tagline: Speech-to-text API for transcription, diarization, and translation.
apis.description: Gladia provides an AI speech API for audio and video transcription with speaker diarization, translation, and real-time streaming. Developers send audio to the API and receive structured transcripts with optional multilingual and post-processing features.

auth.details: API key via x-gladia-key header (self-serve signup).

pricing.free_tier_limits: €50 in one-time free credits with no monthly reset; approximately 80+ hours of pre-recorded or 60+ hours of real-time transcription at current rates.

apis.rate_limits: Starter: 25 concurrent async requests and 30 concurrent real-time requests; Growth: flexible concurrency; Enterprise: unlimited concurrency. Calls-per-hour limits also vary by tier, but numeric caps are not publicly stated.
use_cases: transcribe audio files to text
diarize speakers in a meeting recording
translate speech transcripts to another language
stream real-time speech transcription

apis.name: Glassnode
apis.tagline: On-chain market intelligence metrics for institutional crypto analysis
apis.description: Glassnode provides REST APIs delivering institutional-grade on-chain and market intelligence metrics across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and major crypto assets—including supply dynamics, exchange flows, profitability indicators, network activity, and derivatives data for quantitative research and trading systems.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (also accepted as X-Api-Key header per docs); self-serve from Glassnode Studio account settings

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan includes limited metrics and rate limits (exact quota varies by plan; check studio for current allotment)
pricing.paid_plans: Standard, Professional, and Enterprise tiers with expanded metric catalogs and higher rate limits

apis.rate_limits: Plan-dependent; not fully published without account—check Glassnode Studio/API settings for your tier
use_cases: fetch Bitcoin USD closing price history for backtests
get exchange netflow metrics for on-chain flow analysis
query realized profit/loss indicators by asset
pull active address and network activity time series
export on-chain supply metrics as CSV for quant models

apis.name: GLEIF LEI API
apis.tagline: Global Legal Entity Identifier lookup for standardized entity identity
apis.description: Public REST API from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation providing free access to the Global LEI Index. Lookup LEI records, search legal entities by name or attributes, and retrieve relationship data for KYC, AML, and regulatory compliance workflows.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public open data endpoints; rate limits may apply per IP.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans published for the open API

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: look up a legal entity by LEI code
search LEIs by legal entity name
verify entity status for KYC/AML checks
retrieve parent/child relationship data for corporate hierarchy
enrich compliance records with standardized LEI identity fields

apis.name: GNews
apis.tagline: Real-time news search and headline API with worldwide coverage
apis.description: GNews is a REST API that delivers news articles and top headlines from thousands of sources worldwide. Developers can search by keywords, topics, language, and country, and receive structured article metadata including title, description, content snippet, URL, image, published date, and source.

auth.details: API key via query parameter apikey=YOUR_API_KEY (self-serve signup on gnews.io)

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/day free
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available with higher daily quotas; see pricing page for current tiers

apis.rate_limits: Daily quotas by plan (free: 100 requests/day); Free plan: 1 request/second; paid plans: 10 requests/second
use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword
fetch top headlines for a country or topic
monitor brand or product mentions in news
build a news feed filtered by language
aggregate multi-source coverage on a breaking event

apis.name: Go Module Proxy
apis.tagline: Official Go module download and checksum proxy for the go toolchain
apis.description: Google-operated public Go module mirror used by the go command by default since Go 1.13. It implements the GOPROXY protocol and serves version lists, metadata, go.mod files, and source archives for public modules. It can be disabled or replaced; sum.golang.org is a separate checksum database service.

auth.details: No authentication required for public module downloads

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list available versions of a Go module
download a Go module zip for offline analysis
fetch go.mod contents for a specific module version
resolve latest version info for a Go package

apis.name: Google Books API
apis.tagline: Search and access book metadata, previews, and volume data from Google Books
apis.description: The Google Books API lets developers search the Google Books catalog, retrieve volume metadata (title, authors, ISBN, description, covers), and access user library data. It supports volume search, volume lookups by ID, and authenticated access to a user's bookshelves. Commonly used for book discovery apps, library tools, reading list features, and ISBN lookup.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY for public data; OAuth 2.0 required for user library/bookshelves. Create credentials in Google Cloud Console.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Default 1,000 queries per day per project (Google Cloud Console quotas for books.googleapis.com; increases via Console)
pricing.paid_plans: Google Cloud billing may apply above free quotas

apis.rate_limits: Default ~1,000 queries/day per project (Queries / defaultPerDayPerProject on books.googleapis.com); view/adjust in Cloud Console—no separate public RPM table
use_cases: search books by title, author, or ISBN
look up volume metadata and cover images by book ID
build reading lists or library catalog features
resolve ISBN to title/author/description

apis.name: Google Cloud Natural Language
apis.tagline: Entity, sentiment, and syntax analysis without training models.
apis.description: Google Cloud Natural Language API provides pre-trained machine learning models for entity recognition, sentiment analysis, syntax analysis, and content classification without requiring model training. It supports multiple languages and integrates with other Google Cloud services for text analysis workflows.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter or OAuth2 access token via Authorization: Bearer header. Requires Google Cloud project with Natural Language API enabled.

pricing.free_tier_limits: First 5,000 units/month free for entity, sentiment, syntax, and entity sentiment analysis; first 30,000 units/month free for content classification; first 50,000 units/month free for text moderation. Units are 1,000 characters except moderation units are 100 characters.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go after free tier; pricing varies by feature (entity, sentiment, syntax, classification)

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.request: curl -X POST "https://language.googleapis.com/v1/documents:analyzeSentiment?key=YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"document":{"type":"PLAIN_TEXT","content":"Google Cloud Natural Language is powerful."},"encodingType":"UTF8"}'

use_cases: analyze sentiment of product reviews
extract named entities from news articles
parse syntax and parts of speech in text
classify content into categories
detect language of user-submitted text

apis.name: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text
apis.tagline: Production speech recognition with streaming and many languages
apis.description: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text converts audio to text using machine learning models. It supports batch and streaming recognition, many languages and dialects, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, and automatic punctuation. Developers call the Cloud Speech-to-Text API over HTTPS (and gRPC) under speech.googleapis.com with Google Cloud authentication.

auth.details: Google Cloud OAuth2 access token or service account credentials (Bearer token). API keys are also supported for some REST methods when restricted. Enable Speech-to-Text API in a GCP project.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Speech-to-Text V1: 60 audio minutes per month per account at $0 for Standard models, with or without data logging. V2 has no recurring free allotment in the current pricing table; new customers may separately qualify for Google Cloud trial credits.

apis.rate_limits: V1 defaults per developer project: 900 recognition requests per 60 seconds, 10 adaptation-resource requests per 60 seconds, and 480 audio-processing hours per day. Most quotas can be adjusted through Google Cloud.
use_cases: transcribe a short audio file to text
stream microphone audio for live captions
detect spoken language in an audio clip
get word-level timestamps for subtitles
diarize speakers in a meeting recording

apis.name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
apis.tagline: Neural and WaveNet voices for speech synthesis
apis.description: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech converts text into natural-sounding speech using WaveNet and neural voices. Supports SSML, many languages and voices, and audio formats such as LINEAR16, MP3, and OGG_OPUS. Developers call the REST API at texttospeech.googleapis.com (or client libraries) with Google Cloud credentials.

auth.details: Google Cloud OAuth2 access token (Bearer) or API key; typically service account or Application Default Credentials. API key can be passed as ?key= or x-goog-api-key header for some endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Monthly: 4M characters for WaveNet and Standard; 1M for Chirp 3 HD, Studio, Neural2, and Polyglot. No free usage for Gemini-TTS or Instant Custom Voice. Billing must be enabled.

apis.rate_limits: Per project: Chirp 3 200 RPM; voice cloning 30 RPM; voice-cloning keys 10 RPM; long-audio synthesis and queries 100 RPM each; Neural2, Polyglot, and general requests 1,000 RPM; Studio 500 RPM. Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro: 150/125 QPM; Gemini 3.1 uses dynamic throughput.
use_cases: convert product description text to spoken audio
generate voiceover narration from a script
synthesize accessibility audio for UI strings
create multi-language speech samples for testing

apis.name: Google Cloud Translation
apis.tagline: Neural machine translation for app localization and multilingual content.
apis.description: Google Cloud Translation is a neural machine translation API that translates text between languages for apps, websites, and content workflows. It offers Basic (v2) and Advanced (v3) APIs with support for batch translation, glossaries, and custom models. Developers call REST endpoints under translation.googleapis.com using API keys or OAuth/service accounts.

auth.details: API key via query param key= or OAuth2/service account Bearer token; enable Cloud Translation API in Google Cloud Console.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: translate user-facing strings for app localization
detect language of incoming user text
batch-translate product catalog descriptions
localize help center articles into multiple languages
translate chat messages in real time

apis.name: Google Cloud Video Intelligence API
apis.tagline: AI-powered video analysis: labels, shots, objects, and more
apis.description: Google Cloud Video Intelligence API analyzes video content using machine learning. It detects labels, shot changes, objects, faces, logos, text, and speech; supports object tracking and explicit content detection; and works with files in Cloud Storage or as base64-encoded content. Designed for media indexing, moderation, and searchable video archives.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 access token (Bearer) via Application Default Credentials, service account, or user OAuth. API key supported for some calls. Cloud project with Video Intelligence API enabled required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: First 1,000 minutes of video processed per month free (verify current pricing page)
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go after free tier; priced per minute by feature (label detection, shot change, object tracking, etc.)

apis.rate_limits: not published in full; default Cloud quotas apply — check Quotas page in Cloud Console

example.request: curl -X POST "https://videointelligence.googleapis.com/v1/videos:annotate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" --data '{"inputUri":"gs://YOUR_BUCKET/video.mp4","features":["LABEL_DETECTION"]}'

use_cases: detect object labels and scenes in a video file
find shot changes and scene boundaries in footage
track moving objects across video frames
detect explicit or unsafe content for moderation
extract speech transcripts from video audio
index video archives for searchable media libraries

apis.name: Google Cloud Vision
apis.tagline: Google Cloud image analysis API for labels, OCR, faces, landmarks, and more
apis.description: Google Cloud Vision API detects objects, faces, text, landmarks, logos, and safe-search attributes in images via REST and client libraries. It supports feature detection on local or remote images, document text (OCR), and batch annotation, typically authenticated with a Google Cloud API key or service account and billed per feature unit.

auth.details: API key as query param key=YOUR_API_KEY (or OAuth2/service-account Bearer token). Enable Cloud Vision API in a GCP project; self-serve via Google Cloud Console.

pricing.free_tier_limits: First 1,000 units/month free per feature (label, OCR, face, etc.); web detection 1,000 free; storage/document features have separate free allotments — confirm current pricing page

list downloadable files and formats for a digitized book
find free audio or video items matching a query
resolve an item identifier to direct download URLs

query profiles or segments

check RSVP status for attendees

apis.name: Magic: The Gathering API
apis.tagline: Community MTG card catalog with sets, types, and multiverse IDs
apis.description: Scrydex's current Magic: The Gathering API is a paid, API-key service for card metadata and Lucene-like search, including types, subtypes, supertypes, mana costs, rules, images, expansion data, and opt-in pricing. MTG price-history and webhook endpoints are also documented.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints accept unauthenticated HTTP requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No published free plan. Starter is $29/month with 5,000 API credits; overage is $0.006 per credit. Unauthenticated requests may proceed only at heavily reduced limits.

apis.rate_limits: 100 requests/second for all plans, plus plan-based API-credit allowances. Most standard requests cost 1 credit; usage beyond included credits incurs plan-specific overage charges.
use_cases: look up MTG card details by name or multiverse ID
list cards in a specific set by set code
fetch legal card types, subtypes, and supertypes
search cards by color, rarity, or mana cost filters
get MTG set metadata and release information

apis.name: Mailchimp
apis.tagline: Marketing platform API for email campaigns, audiences, and automations
apis.description: Mailchimp provides a REST API for managing email marketing audiences, campaigns, automations, templates, and reporting. Developers authenticate with API keys scoped to a datacenter-specific base URL, then create and manage lists, send campaigns, and pull engagement analytics programmatically.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth (anystring:API_KEY) or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; key suffix encodes datacenter (e.g. us19). Self-serve from account settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free marketing plan: contact and monthly send caps on current pricing (limits change; verify on mailchimp.com/pricing). API access available on free accounts.

apis.rate_limits: 10 simultaneously processing Marketing API requests per user; excess requests return 429. No per-customer increase is currently available.
use_cases: add or update a subscriber on an audience list
create and send an email campaign
list audience members and their status
trigger or manage marketing automations
pull campaign open and click reports

apis.name: Mailgun
apis.tagline: Transactional email API for sending, receiving, and tracking email at scale
apis.description: Mailgun (Sinch) is a developer-focused email delivery platform with a REST API for sending transactional and bulk email, inbound parsing/routing, templates, webhooks, suppressions, and analytics. US and EU regions are available; API access uses HTTP Basic Auth with private API keys. No forever-free production tier; paid plans start at Basic (~$15/mo for 10,000 emails/mo) with free trials on higher tiers.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth: username `api`, password = private API key (or domain sending key for /messages only). Keys from dashboard Account Settings → API Keys after self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No forever-free production plan. Free trial available on paid plans (Foundation/Scale include ~1-month trial); sandbox for testing. Paid plans start at Basic (~$15/mo for 10k emails/mo). Confirm current allotments on mailgun.com/pricing.
pricing.paid_plans: Basic from $15/mo (10k emails/mo); Foundation $35/mo (50k, 1-mo free trial); Scale $90/mo (100k, 1-mo free trial); Enterprise custom. Overages ~$1.10–$1.80 per 1k emails.

apis.rate_limits: Varies by endpoint/account; response headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset; 429 on exceed. Metrics API: 500 req/10s. New accounts may face temporary hourly send caps until business verification.

example.request: curl --user 'api:YOUR_API_KEY' https://api.mailgun.net/v3/YOUR_DOMAIN_NAME/messages -F from='Mailgun Sandbox <postmaster@YOUR_DOMAIN_NAME>' -F to='recipient@example.com' -F subject='Hello' -F text='Testing Mailgun'

use_cases: send a transactional email via REST API
queue a password-reset or order-confirmation message
list or manage sending domains and DNS settings
fetch message events, bounces, or delivery logs
set up inbound email routes or webhooks for open/click events
validate an email address before adding it to a list

apis.name: Mailjet
apis.tagline: European email API for transactional and marketing mail
apis.description: Mailjet provides REST APIs for sending transactional and marketing email, managing contacts, lists, and templates, and retrieving statistics and events. Email API v3/v3.1 uses HTTPS Basic Auth with an API key and secret; SMS API v4 uses Bearer-token authentication. Its email infrastructure is GDPR-compliant and EU-hosted.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with API key as username and secret key as password; keys from account settings. Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 6,000 emails per month, maximum 200 emails per day, and up to 1,000 contacts.

apis.rate_limits: API calls are limited per API key per second; universal numeric thresholds are not published. Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429. Transactional APIs have higher limits than other Email and SMS APIs.
use_cases: send a transactional email with HTML and text body
send a campaign email using a stored template
list or create contacts and contact lists
retrieve delivery open and bounce statistics
manage sender domains and validate sender addresses

apis.name: MalwareBazaar
apis.tagline: Community malware sample exchange and hash-lookup API from abuse.ch
apis.description: MalwareBazaar (abuse.ch) is a free community API for sharing confirmed malware samples and querying sample intelligence by hash, tag, signature, filetype, YARA, imphash, and related pivots. Developers POST form data to a single v1 endpoint with an Auth-Key header to look up metadata, download zipped samples (password: infected), upload samples, and pull recent detections. Commercial/high-volume use may require Spamhaus’s enhanced abuse.ch API.

auth.details: Auth-Key via HTTP header Auth-Key: <key>. Free self-serve key from abuse.ch Authentication Portal (auth.abuse.ch). Required for all community API calls since mid-2025.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Community API free under fair use for non-commercial use; sample downloads capped at 2,000 per IP/day; general query quotas not published as fixed numbers
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial/for-profit use may require Spamhaus enhanced abuse.ch API (quote-based; 30-day free trial via Spamhaus portal)

apis.rate_limits: File download API: 2,000 downloads per IP address/day. Other query rate limits not published; subject to fair-use enforcement.
use_cases: look up malware family and metadata for a file hash
download a known malware sample by SHA256 (zipped, password infected)
list recent samples associated with a tag or malware signature
get recent family-labeled detections for threat hunting
find related samples by imphash, TLSH, or YARA rule
upload a confirmed malware sample with tags and context

apis.name: Mapbox
apis.tagline: Maps, geocoding, directions, and location services for web and mobile apps.
apis.description: Mapbox provides APIs and SDKs for interactive maps, geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing/directions, matrix travel times, isochrones, map matching, static map images, and tile services. Developers authenticate with an access token, call REST endpoints under api.mapbox.com, and render results with Mapbox GL JS or native SDKs. Common building blocks include Styles, Tilesets, the Geocoding API, and the Directions API for turn-by-turn navigation and place search.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier includes monthly free usage allowances that vary by product (e.g. map loads, geocoding requests, directions); exact free units listed on pricing page and may change—verify current allowances on mapbox.com/pricing.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go after free tier; volume pricing and enterprise plans available. Priced per product (Maps, Navigation, Search, etc.).

apis.rate_limits: Product-specific rate limits apply (e.g. Geocoding and Directions have documented default request rates); higher limits available on paid/enterprise. Check docs per API product.
use_cases: geocode a place name to coordinates
reverse-geocode lat/lng to an address
get driving directions between two points
render a static map image for a location
get travel-time matrix between multiple origins and destinations
search for nearby places or POIs

apis.name: MapQuest
apis.tagline: Mapping, geocoding, directions, and place search APIs for location-aware applications
apis.description: MapQuest provides REST APIs for geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing/directions, static and interactive maps, place search, and traffic data. auth.details: API key via key query parameter (e.g. ?key=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve signup at developer.mapquest.com

apis.rate_limits: not published

generate a static map image for a location
search for nearby places by category

pricing.free_tier_limits: no free tier

apis.name: MarketAux

get market news with sentiment scores for portfolio monitoring
filter news by industry, country, or entity type
build a market sentiment dashboard from multi-source headlines
aggregate real-time company news for trading signals

apis.name: Marketstack
apis.tagline: Real-time, intraday, and historical stock market data API for global exchanges.

apis.name: Marvel Comics API

apis.name: Mastodon
apis.tagline: Decentralized social networking API for federated Mastodon instances
apis.description: Mastodon is a free, open-source, decentralized social network based on ActivityPub. apis.name: Matrix

apis.rate_limits: not published globally; homeserver-dependent (matrix.org and other hosts apply their own limits)

apis.name: Maven Central Search API

apis.description: The Maven Central Search API provides programmatic access to search, resolve, and retrieve metadata for artifacts published to Maven Central Repository. Developers can query by groupId, artifactId, version, class names, and other coordinates to discover packages and dependencies.

apis.name: Maxio Advanced Billing (Chargify)

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published

join planetary system tables via ADQL TAP queries

search NASA image and video library

apis.name: NASA POWER
apis.tagline: NASA agroclimatology solar, temperature, and precipitation by lat/lon
apis.description: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) provides satellite- and model-based agroclimatology parameters (solar irradiance, temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind) at point locations for crop modeling, energy, and climate applications via a public REST API.

query multi-year climate normals for planting decisions

pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based and subscription plans for premium datasets and higher limits

apis.rate_limits: Non-premium authenticated: 300/10s, 2,000/10 min, 50,000/day, concurrency 1. Premium (tables sub): 5,000/10 min, 720,000/day. Anonymous: 20/10 min, 50/day. Bulk export: 60/hour.

example.response_snippet: {"datatable":{"data":[[...]],"columns":[{"name":"...","type":"..."}]},"meta":{"next_cursor_id":null}} (tables JSON shape; live rows require a free API key—endpoint returns QEPx04 without key, not 410)

pull economic indicator time series
export table datasets to CSV for analysis
backtest strategies with historical market data

apis.name: Navitia
apis.tagline: Multimodal public-transport journey planner with open data and free developer access
apis.description: Navitia is a multimodal trip-planning API covering public transit, bike, walking, and car. Developers query coverage regions, stop areas, schedules, and door-to-door journeys. Authentication uses a self-serve API key; free tiers and paid plans are documented on the vendor site.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic auth (key as username, empty password) or Authorization header; self-serve signup at navitia.io

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

geocode places near transit for routing

apis.name: NBA Stats API

pricing.free_tier_limits: No published free tier or paid plans; publicly callable without key, subject to undocumented throttling and ToS

apis.name: NCBI E-utilities
apis.description: NCBI E-utilities (Entrez Programming Utilities) is a free set of server-side programs for programmatic HTTP access to Entrez/NCBI databases (PubMed, GenBank, Protein, etc.), returning XML, JSON, or other formats depending on utility and parameters. Optional free API key raises rate limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No paid tier. Free public access: 3 req/s without API key; 10 req/s with free API key (NCBI account). No formal volume cap beyond rate limits and usage policies; contact eutilities@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov for higher throughput.

apis.rate_limits: Without API key: ≤3 req/s. With free API key: ≤10 req/s (higher by request to eutilities@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov). Limit is request start rate, not concurrency. retrieve abstracts and citation metadata for PubMed records
download GenBank nucleotide sequences by accession number
look up protein records and sequences
find related articles or linked records across NCBI databases

apis.name: Netlify API
apis.tagline: Jamstack hosting REST API for sites, deploys, forms, and edge functions
apis.description: REST API for Netlify's platform: manage sites, deploys, builds, forms, edge functions, DNS, and account resources. Used for CI automation, programmatic site management, and integrating Netlify into developer tooling and agent workflows.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 300 credits per month; this is a hard limit. When exhausted, all projects pause until the next billing cycle unless the account upgrades. Auto recharge is unavailable on Free.

apis.rate_limits: Up to 500 requests per minute for most requests. Some operations have stricter limits; API deploys are limited to 3 per minute and 100 per day.
use_cases: list all sites on a Netlify account
trigger or inspect a site deploy
read form submissions for a Netlify form
manage DNS records for a Netlify domain
create or update environment variables for a site
check build and deploy status for CI automation

apis.name: New Relic API
apis.tagline: Observability platform API for metrics, logs, APM, and account management
apis.description: New Relic provides REST and GraphQL (NerdGraph) APIs for querying telemetry, managing alerts, entities, and accounts across its observability platform. Developers use user API keys or license keys with HTTPS endpoints for data ingest and query.

auth.details: API key via Api-Key header (NerdGraph/REST) or X-License-Key for ingest; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 GB/month data ingest, 1 full platform user, unlimited basic users (API quotas not separately itemized)

apis.rate_limits: NerdGraph: 25 concurrent requests per user, no general requests-per-minute limit; REST API v2: 1,000 calls/minute; NRQL API queries: 3,000/account/minute.

list and manage New Relic alerts and conditions
ingest custom metrics or events
fetch entity inventory and relationships
run NRQL queries via NerdGraph

apis.name: News API AI

apis.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim

apis.description: Nominatim is OpenStreetMap’s free geocoding service for forward search (place names to coordinates), reverse geocoding (coordinates to addresses), and structured address lookups. Responses are typically JSON (or XML/GeoJSON) and require a valid User-Agent or email for identification.

auth.details: No API key. Public instance requires a valid HTTP User-Agent identifying the application, and preferably a contact email (via User-Agent or email= query param). No self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public instance free for policy-compliant light use (including moderate end-user-triggered app/website use); no SLA—access may be withdrawn; commercial apps should not depend on continued availability; heavy/regular bulk use must self-host or use third-party providers
pricing.paid_plans: No paid plans from OSM; commercial Nominatim hosting available from third parties (e.g. LocationIQ, Geoapify, self-hosted)

apis.rate_limits: Absolute maximum 1 request/second on public nominatim.openstreetmap.org; identify with valid User-Agent or Referer; cache results. Bulk geocoding discouraged—smaller one-time jobs may be allowed (single thread, one machine); scripts lasting over a day or run regularly limited to 4 requests/minute. Systematic queries, autocomplete-on-API, and reselling primary geocoding services forbidden.
use_cases: geocode a place name or address to latitude/longitude
reverse-geocode coordinates to a human-readable address
look up OpenStreetMap place IDs and bounding boxes for a location
autocomplete or disambiguate place names for map UIs
resolve structured address components (street, city, country) to coordinates

apis.name: NOWPayments API

query wind resource or related renewable datasets for modeling

apis.name: NYC Open Data API
apis.tagline: Socrata-powered API for New York City public datasets and city records.
apis.description: NYC Open Data exposes thousands of City of New York datasets through a SODA (Socrata Open Data API) interface on data.cityofnewyork.us. Developers can query JSON, CSV, and other formats for 311 complaints, taxi trips, inspections, permits, and more. Authentication is optional for light public use and recommended via app token for higher throughput.

auth.details: Optional. Public SODA reads work without credentials. A free Socrata app token (X-App-Token header or $$app_token query param) is not authentication; it identifies the app for a higher request pool vs low anonymous IP throttling. OAuth/user auth is separate and only needed for private/write access.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; higher throughput with free app token (exact quotas not published as a paid product).

apis.rate_limits: Without app token: much lower IP-based throttling (exact threshold unpublished). With app token: substantially higher application-scoped limits; requests are generally unthrottled except under abuse/malicious traffic. Historical ~1,000 req/hour figures are not current official docs.
use_cases: query recent 311 service requests by borough or complaint type
fetch restaurant inspection grades and scores
pull taxi or for-hire vehicle trip sample records
list building permits or housing violations for an address
export open dataset rows as JSON or CSV for analysis

use_cases: generate chat completions with a GPT model

generate or edit images from a prompt
transcribe audio to text with Whisper
build agent tools that call models via the Responses API

apis.name: OpenAlex
apis.tagline: Open scholarly graph of works, authors, institutions, and citations
apis.description: OpenAlex is a free, open scholarly metadata graph covering works, authors, institutions, sources, concepts, and citations. It provides a REST API for searching and retrieving bibliographic and research-output data at scale, suitable for discovery, bibliometrics, and research analytics.

auth.details: Free API key required via api_key query param (get at openalex.org/settings/api). Unauthenticated demo use may work limitedly.

pricing.free_tier_limits: $1/day free usage credit; singleton entity lookups free; lists/searches/content incur endpoint-based costs.
pricing.paid_plans: Prepaid/paid usage after free daily credit; higher tiers via OpenAlex pricing/contact.

apis.rate_limits: Max 100 requests/second; daily usage limited by key credit allowance ($1 free/day).

example.response_snippet: {"id":"https://openalex.org/W2741809807","doi":"https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.4375","title":"The state of OA: a large-scale analysis of the prevalence and impact of Open Access articles","publication_year":2018}

use_cases: search scholarly works by title or DOI
look up an author's publications and citation counts
resolve institution metadata from OpenAlex IDs
fetch citation and reference graphs for a paper

apis.name: OpenAQ
apis.tagline: Global air quality measurements from public sensors
apis.description: OpenAQ is a public API that aggregates real-time and historical air quality measurements from government and research-grade sensors worldwide.
