auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header; free self-serve key from OpenAQ Explore after account signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: 60 requests/minute, 2,000 requests/hour (free/general tier); higher limits available via custom paid contact

apis.rate_limits: 60 requests/minute and 2,000 requests/hour per API key (free/general use); 429 when exceeded; custom higher limits available
use_cases: get latest PM2.5 readings near a city
list air quality monitoring locations in a country
fetch historical measurements for a sensor
query global air quality by parameter
find sensors within a bounding box

apis.name: OpenCage Geocoding
apis.tagline: Forward and reverse geocoding with global coverage
apis.description: OpenCage Geocoding API converts addresses to coordinates and coordinates to addresses using aggregated open data. It provides structured place data, timezone, annotations, and confidence scores for apps that need reliable place lookup worldwide.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (self-serve signup)

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free trial for testing only (not ongoing free tier): 2,500 requests/day, 1 req/s; no credit card required. Inactive trials deleted after 3 months.
pricing.paid_plans: Subscriptions from $50/mo (X-Small: 10k req/day, 15 req/s); Small $125, Medium $500, Large $1000; Enterprise from $2000/mo. Also one-time plans.

apis.rate_limits: Free trial: 1 req/s. Paid plans: higher by tier (e.g. 15–50 req/s) plus daily/monthly caps by plan.
use_cases: convert a street address to latitude/longitude
reverse-geocode coordinates to a place name
look up timezone for a location
normalize user-entered place strings

apis.name: OpenCorporates
apis.tagline: World's largest open database of companies and corporate ownership networks
apis.description: OpenCorporates provides programmatic access to company registry data, officers, filings, and corporate ownership relationships across many jurisdictions. Developers use it for KYC, due diligence, entity resolution, and graph-style linkage of companies and people. The API returns structured company records with registry identifiers, status, registered addresses, and related entities.

auth.details: API token via api_token query parameter (or account signup); free accounts limited; paid plans for higher volume

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API accounts are limited to qualifying open-data projects/products released under share-alike attribution terms. The default allowance is 50 requests/day and 200 requests/month; actual limits vary by account type and plan.

apis.rate_limits: Default quota: 50 requests/day and 200 requests/month. Actual limits depend on account type and plan; rate-limited requests receive HTTP 403.
use_cases: search companies by name across global registries
look up a company by jurisdiction and company number
list officers and directors for a company
trace corporate ownership and network relationships
enrich KYC or due-diligence workflows with registry status

apis.name: OpenDota
apis.tagline: Free open-source Dota 2 match, hero, and player analytics API
apis.description: Open-source API providing Dota 2 match data, player statistics, hero analytics, rankings, and pro scene data. Offers generous free access with optional API key for higher rate limits. Community-driven project with comprehensive endpoints for match history, live games, and performance metrics.

auth.details: Optional API key via api_key query parameter for higher rate limits. Self-serve signup at opendota.com/api-keys. Unauthenticated requests allowed at lower limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 60 requests/minute without a key; free API key: 60 requests/minute and 50,000 requests/month
pricing.paid_plans: Premium plans available for higher limits

apis.rate_limits: 60 req/min unauthenticated; free API key: 60 req/min and 50,000/month; paid tiers for higher
use_cases: get recent matches for a Dota 2 player by account ID
fetch hero statistics and win rates
look up pro player rankings and team data
get detailed match analysis including item builds and gold graphs
search players by name
retrieve live game data

apis.name: OpenEI Utility Rate Database
apis.tagline: US utility electricity rate structures and tariffs via free OpenEI web services
apis.description: OpenEI Utility Rate Database provides free web services for US utility electricity rate structures and tariffs, enabling developers to query rates by utility, location, or sector for energy analysis, solar modeling, and bill estimation.

auth.details: API key required via api_key query parameter; obtain free key from OpenEI

pricing.free_tier_limits: Default: 1,000 requests per hour per API key; service-specific limits may vary. DEMO_KEY: 30 requests per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day.

apis.rate_limits: Default: 1,000 requests per hour per API key across api.data.gov APIs; service-specific limits may vary. DEMO_KEY: 30 per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day.
use_cases: get electricity rates for a US utility
look up rate structures by zip code
compare residential vs commercial tariffs
fetch time-of-use rate schedules

apis.name: OpenFDA API
apis.tagline: U.S. FDA public datasets for drugs, devices, food, and adverse events
apis.description: OpenFDA provides REST access to U.S. Food and Drug Administration public data, including drug and device adverse events, product labeling, recalls, and other regulated-product datasets. Developers query structured endpoints with optional API keys for higher rate limits, making it useful for pharmacovigilance research, compliance tooling, and consumer-safety applications.

auth.details: Optional API key as query parameter api_key=YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve key via open.fda.gov. Unauthenticated access allowed at lower rate limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; higher limits with free API key (see rate_limits)

apis.rate_limits: Without key: 240 req/min, 1,000/day (per IP). With key: 240 req/min, 120,000/day (per key).

example.response_snippet: {"meta":{"disclaimer":"Do not rely on openFDA to make decisions regarding medical care...","results":{"skip":0,"limit":1,"total":...}},"results":[{"safetyreportid":"...","patient":{...}}]}

use_cases: search FDA drug adverse event reports by brand or generic name
look up drug labeling and indications from FDA label data
query medical device recalls and adverse events
find food enforcement and recall notices
check NDC or product codes against openFDA drug datasets

apis.name: OpenFEC API
apis.tagline: Federal campaign finance data: candidates, committees, contributions, and filings
apis.description: Public REST API from the U.S. Federal Election Commission providing structured access to campaign finance disclosure data—candidates, committees, itemized receipts and disbursements, independent expenditures, filings, and election results. Data is sourced from FEC filings and updated as reports are processed. Requires a free API key; rate limits apply.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (or DEMO_KEY for light testing). Free key from api.data.gov signup; required for production use.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free via api.data.gov key; default 1,000 requests/hour (confirm current data.gov limits)

apis.rate_limits: Default ~1,000 requests/hour per API key via api.data.gov; DEMO_KEY has lower shared limits
use_cases: search presidential or congressional candidates by cycle and office
look up PAC or candidate committee registration and totals
list itemized individual contributions to a committee
fetch independent expenditure reports for an election
get schedule filings and financial summary totals for a candidate

apis.name: OpenFIGI
apis.tagline: Bloomberg FIGI security identifier mapping for financial instruments
apis.description: OpenFIGI provides a free, open API for mapping third-party financial-instrument identifiers to FIGIs and for searching and filtering instruments and Open Symbology metadata. Official sources do not offer or document paid API access.

auth.details: Optional API key via X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY header for higher rate limits; self-serve signup. Unauthenticated requests allowed at lower limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API with no daily, weekly, or monthly limit. Mapping: 25 requests/minute without a key or 25 requests/6 seconds with a key. Search/filter: 5 requests/minute without a key or 20/minute with a key; maximum 15,000 results, 100 per page, and 150 pages.

apis.rate_limits: Mapping: 25 requests/minute without an API key or 25 requests/6 seconds with one. Search/filter: 5 requests/minute without an API key or 20 requests/minute with one.
use_cases: map a ticker or ISIN to Bloomberg FIGI for regulatory reporting
batch-resolve CUSIP/SEDOL identifiers to FIGIs
search financial instruments by name or symbol
normalize security identifiers across market data feeds

apis.name: OpenFlights
apis.tagline: Open airline, airport, and route datasets for aviation apps
apis.description: OpenFlights documents downloadable CSV-format airport, airline, route, plane, and country datasets. Files served from raw.githubusercontent.com are sporadically updated static snapshots of the live database. Route data stopped updating in June 2014 and is historical only.

auth.details: No authentication required; data files are publicly downloadable

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free data downloads; unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com downloads may be rate-limited by GitHub, with no numeric threshold published.

apis.rate_limits: GitHub rate-limits unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com downloads; no numeric threshold is officially published.
use_cases: look up airport coordinates by IATA code from airports.dat
build airline route graphs from routes.dat
resolve airline names and ICAO codes from airlines.dat
seed local aviation reference DBs for flight apps
map airport timezones for schedule UIs

apis.name: OpenHolidays API
apis.tagline: Free open-data API for European public and school holidays
apis.description: OpenHolidays API is a free open-data REST API for public and school holidays in supported countries across Europe, the Americas, and Africa. It provides endpoints for countries, languages, subdivisions, groups, holidays, and localized names without documented authentication. Holiday range queries are limited to three years.

auth.details: No authentication required; free unrestricted public access with no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for commercial use. Public- and school-holiday query date ranges may not exceed three years. No request-volume quota is documented.

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list public holidays for a European country and year
get school holidays by country or subdivision
check if a date is a public holiday
build localized holiday calendars for multi-country apps
populate HR or scheduling systems with regional holidays

apis.name: OpenLigaDB
apis.tagline: Free German football league data API covering Bundesliga and more
apis.description: OpenLigaDB provides free, unrestricted HTTP access to German open football league data including Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga, and other competitions. Developers can query match results, standings, teams, and goals without authentication. The public REST-style API returns JSON and is commonly used for live scores, historical fixtures, and league table apps.

auth.details: No authentication required; public HTTP endpoints with unrestricted access

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: get Bundesliga match results for a season
fetch current league table standings
look up upcoming fixtures for a team
pull goal scorers for a match

apis.name: OpenRouter
apis.tagline: Unified API gateway for 300+ language models from many providers
apis.description: OpenRouter provides a single OpenAI-compatible HTTP API that routes chat and completion requests across hundreds of models from many providers. Developers authenticate with an API key, select models by name, and can use provider routing, usage tracking, and optional fallbacks without integrating each model vendor separately.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; self-serve signup at openrouter.ai. Optionally set HTTP-Referer and X-Title for app attribution.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free models available; paid models billed per token with account credits. Exact free allowance depends on selected free models—verify current list on openrouter.ai/models.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go per model token rates; credits purchased on account. Some models free; others charged by input/output tokens.

apis.rate_limits: Free models (:free): 20 RPM / 50 RPD if <10 credits purchased all-time; 20 RPM / 1,000 RPD after ≥10 credits. Account-wide, not per model. Provider-specific and Cloudflare DDoS limits also apply; paid variants have no platform request cap.
use_cases: chat complete with a specific model by OpenRouter model id
list available models and pricing metadata
route LLM calls across providers with one OpenAI-compatible client
get account credits and generation usage for a request

apis.name: OpenRouteService
apis.tagline: Open-source routing, geocoding, isochrones, and matrix APIs over OpenStreetMap
apis.description: OpenRouteService (ORS) provides free and paid HTTP APIs for car/bike/foot routing, distance matrices, isochrones, geocoding/reverse geocoding, POI search, elevation, and optimization on OpenStreetMap data. auth.details: API key via Authorization header (or api_key query param on some endpoints); free self-serve signup at openrouteservice.org

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 2,000 directions requests/day, ~40 requests/minute (endpoint-dependent daily caps; matrix/isochrones lower). See https://openrouteservice.org/plans/

apis.rate_limits: Published on plans page: free ~40 req/min and 2,000 req/day directions (endpoint-dependent); higher on paid plans
use_cases: get driving directions between two coordinates
compute travel-time isochrones around a point
build a distance/duration matrix for many origins and destinations
geocode an address to coordinates
optimize a multi-stop delivery route

apis.name: OpenSanctions
apis.tagline: Consolidated global sanctions, PEPs, and watchlist matching API
apis.description: OpenSanctions provides a consolidated API for global sanctions lists, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and watchlist screening for AML and compliance workflows. It offers entity search, matching, and bulk data access across multiple official sources.

auth.details: API key authentication; exact header and signup flow need verification from official docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: Business-email signups receive a 30-day trial. Ongoing free API keys are grants limited to verified public-interest journalism, civil-society advocacy, qualifying academic research, and specified public institutions.

match customer data against PEPs and watchlists
look up an entity by OpenSanctions ID
bulk-export sanctioned entities for offline screening

list marketplace events

apis.name: OpenSky Network
apis.tagline: ADS-B aircraft state vectors free for non-commercial use

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use; rate limits apply to anonymous and authenticated users

apis.rate_limits: Anonymous: ~10 requests per 10 seconds; Authenticated: higher limits (see docs)
use_cases: get live aircraft positions in a bounding box
track a specific aircraft by ICAO24 code
fetch historical flight tracks for analysis
monitor air traffic density over a region
build a flight radar style map overlay

apis.name: OpenTable API
apis.tagline: Partner API for restaurant search, availability, and reservation booking.
apis.description: OpenTable provides approval-gated APIs for restaurant directory data, availability and booking, reservations, guests, CRM, and operational integrations. Production access requires review and a formal agreement. OAuth 2.0 is the primary authorization mechanism, and the current public documentation is hosted at docs.opentable.com.

auth.details: Partner/program credentials; self-serve public API key signup not confirmed from public docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown
pricing.paid_plans: Partner/commercial pricing; public self-serve tiers not published

use_cases: search restaurants by location or cuisine
check table availability for a party size and time
create or cancel a restaurant reservation
retrieve restaurant details and booking policies

apis.name: Open Trivia DB
apis.tagline: Free community trivia questions by category, difficulty, and type
apis.description: Open Trivia Database (OpenTDB) is a free, user-contributed trivia question bank with a simple JSON HTTP API. Developers request questions with query params (amount, category, difficulty, type, encoding) and optional session tokens to avoid duplicates. No API key or signup is required. auth.details: No API key or signup. Optional session token via GET /api_token.php?command=request; pass as token= query param to avoid duplicate questions. Tokens expire after 6 hours of inactivity.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Completely free; no key or paid tier. Max 50 questions/call; 1 category/call; 1 request per 5 seconds per IP.

apis.rate_limits: 1 request per 5 seconds per IP (response_code 5 / HTTP 429 if exceeded). Max 50 questions per call; only 1 category per call.

example.response_snippet: {"response_code":0,"results":[{"type":"multiple","difficulty":"easy","category":"General Knowledge","question":"What are Panama hats made out of?","correct_answer":"Straw","incorrect_answers":["Silk","Hemp","Flax"]}]}

use_cases: fetch random trivia questions for a quiz app
list trivia categories and their IDs
get N multiple-choice questions filtered by category and difficulty
request a session token to avoid repeat questions in a game
look up verified question counts per category or globally

apis.name: OpenTopoMap
apis.tagline: Free topographic map tiles from OSM and SRTM elevation data
apis.description: OpenTopoMap is a free topographic map tile service that renders OpenStreetMap data with SRTM elevation into classic contour-style map tiles. Developers typically load XYZ raster tiles at zoom levels for outdoor, hiking, and terrain-focused maps.

auth.details: No API key required for public tile usage. Usage is subject to fair-use and attribution requirements on the project site.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public free tile access; no published paid plans. Respect fair-use limits from the project.

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.response_snippet: HTTP 200 OK; Content-Type: image/png; binary PNG raster tile saved as tile.png.

show hiking terrain with contour-style basemap
add outdoor-oriented OSM tiles to a mobile map view
prefetch XYZ topo tiles for offline cache

apis.name: OpenTripMap
apis.tagline: Worldwide tourist attractions and points of interest API for travel apps
apis.description: OpenTripMap provides geospatial access to tourist attractions, landmarks, and points of interest worldwide. auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter; free self-serve registration on opentripmap.io

pricing.free_tier_limits: Non-commercial use; 5,000 requests per day; 10 requests per second

apis.rate_limits: 10 requests per second on the Free plan
use_cases: list tourist attractions near a lat/lon within a radius
get place details and Wikipedia extract by xid
search points of interest by name or bounding box
filter attractions by category kinds for a map layer

apis.name: OpenTripPlanner
apis.tagline: Open-source multimodal trip planner with HTTP routing APIs
apis.description: OpenTripPlanner (OTP) is an open-source multimodal journey planning engine that combines transit schedules (GTFS/GTFS-RT), OSM street data, and optional bike/car networks into a routing graph. pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source software: unlimited use when self-hosted. Public demo instances are free but informal (no published quota).

apis.rate_limits: not published (self-hosted: operator-defined; public demos have no documented limits)

list nearby transit stops or routes for a map location
compute isochrones / travel-time polygons from a point

geocode-adjacent routing for last-mile bike or micromobility legs

apis.name: OpenUV
apis.tagline: Real-time and forecast UV index API for outdoor health apps
apis.description: OpenUV provides real-time UV index, sun position, and multi-day UV forecast data by latitude/longitude. Commonly used for skin-health, outdoor recreation, and weather apps that need UV exposure guidance beyond basic weather conditions.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 50 requests/day free (Personal/Free Forever plan; no card required)
pricing.paid_plans: Start-Up plan $15 USD/month for up to 15,000 requests/day (Stripe); Unlimited plan via support@openuv.io

fetch multi-day UV forecast for a location
estimate safe sun exposure time by skin type
get sunrise/sunset and sun position for outdoor planning

apis.name: OpenWeatherMap
apis.tagline: Global weather data API for current conditions, forecasts, historical data, and air quality.
apis.description: OpenWeatherMap provides weather data APIs covering current weather, multi-day forecasts, historical archives, and air pollution for locations worldwide. pricing.paid_plans: Startup, Developer, Professional, Expert, Enterprise tiers with higher limits and products.

get 5-day / 3-hour forecast for coordinates
fetch air pollution / AQI for a location
look up weather by ZIP or city ID
power weather widgets or alerts in an app

apis.name: OpenXBL
apis.tagline: Self-serve Xbox Live profiles, presence, achievements, and friends API
apis.description: OpenXBL provides third-party developers with REST access to Xbox Live profile, presence, achievements, friends, and related social data via the xbl.io platform. pricing.free_tier_limits: 150 requests per hour indefinitely; no credit card required.

use_cases: look up Xbox profile by gamertag or XUID
check a player's current presence or online status
list achievements for a title or player
fetch friends list and social graph
get recent games or activity for a player

apis.name: OSRM

build a distance or duration matrix for many origin-destination pairs
snap GPS traces to roads with map matching
find the nearest road network point to a coordinate
solve traveling-salesman style trip optimization for a set of stops

apis.name: OSV
apis.tagline: Google-backed open-source vulnerability database with package-level queries across ecosystems
apis.description: Public vulnerability database and API for querying vulnerabilities by package version, commit, or OSV identifier across open-source ecosystems.

apis.rate_limits: Currently no API rate limit is documented.

query vulnerabilities by Git commit hash

get vulnerability details by OSV or CVE ID

integrate vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines

apis.name: OpenStreetMap Overpass API
apis.tagline: Query OpenStreetMap map data with a flexible Overpass QL language
apis.description: The Overpass API is a read-only API that serves up custom selected parts of the OpenStreetMap map data. It is optimized for data consumers that need a few elements within a bounding box or matching certain tags, rather than bulk downloads of the whole planet.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public read-only endpoint; heavy use may be throttled or blocked by the public instance.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public instance; fair-use policy applies (no formal free-tier quota published as a fixed req/day number)
pricing.paid_plans: Self-host or use commercial Overpass providers; public instance has no paid plans

apis.rate_limits: Main public instance fair-use: under ~10,000 queries/day and under ~1 GB download/day. example.response_snippet: {"version":0.6,"generator":"Overpass API","osm3s":{"timestamp_osm_base":"2026-...","copyright":"The data included in this document is from www.openstreetmap.org..."},"elements":[{"type":"node","id":123,"lat":48.85,"lon":2.29,"tags":{"amenity":"cafe","name":"Example"}}]}

get OSM ways/nodes matching tags near a point
export a small area of map features as GeoJSON-friendly JSON
query building footprints or roads in a region
check if a POI exists in OpenStreetMap by name/tag

apis.name: OwnTracks
apis.tagline: Privacy-focused location tracking via HTTP and MQTT
apis.description: OwnTracks is an open-source location sharing protocol and ecosystem for personal and small-fleet tracking. Mobile apps publish location updates over MQTT or HTTP; backends and tools consume a documented JSON message format for live position, history, and geofencing.

auth.details: Self-hosted: MQTT username/password or HTTP basic/auth as configured on your OwnTracks recorder or broker. No central OwnTracks cloud API key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source self-hosted software; no paid cloud API from OwnTracks. Costs are your own server/broker hosting.

apis.rate_limits: not published (depends on self-hosted recorder/broker configuration)
use_cases: publish a device location update to a self-hosted OwnTracks recorder over HTTP
parse OwnTracks JSON location messages from MQTT for a private map
ingest transition/geofence enter-leave events from OwnTracks apps
build a privacy-first family or fleet tracker without a third-party cloud

apis.name: Oxford Dictionaries
apis.tagline: Premium lexical data from Oxford University Press
apis.description: Oxford Dictionaries API provides dictionary definitions, translations, thesauri, and lexical data from Oxford University Press for English and other languages. Access headword lookups, senses, examples, pronunciations, and related linguistic data via REST endpoints for language apps, writing tools, and educational products.

auth.details: App ID and App Key via app_id and app_key headers after signup on the developer portal

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.response_snippet: {"id":"ace","metadata":{"operation":"retrieve"},"results":[{"id":"ace","language":"en-us","lexicalEntries":[{"entries":[{"senses":[{"definitions":["a playing card with a single spot"]}]}]}]}]}

use_cases: look up dictionary definitions for a word
get thesaurus synonyms and antonyms
fetch word pronunciations and audio
translate words between supported languages
retrieve example sentences for a sense

apis.name: Packagist API
apis.tagline: Public Composer package registry API for PHP package discovery and metadata
apis.description: Packagist is the default Composer package repository. Its public API exposes package listings, metadata, search, and statistics so tools can resolve package names, versions, and download counts without scraping the website.

auth.details: Most public read endpoints require no authentication. Authenticated write or private-package flows use Packagist account credentials if applicable.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: No hard req/min quotas published. Soft limits/guidance on apidoc: max 10 concurrent requests (20 for static files); spread load; avoid XX:00 crons; send User-Agent with mailto. Prefer static repo.packagist.org metadata.
use_cases: list all package names on Packagist
fetch package metadata and versions for a Composer package
search packages by keyword
get package download statistics

apis.name: Paddle API
apis.tagline: Merchant of Record payments, subscriptions, and billing for software
apis.description: Paddle is a Merchant of Record platform that handles payments, subscriptions, tax, and compliance for software companies. Its REST API lets you manage products, prices, customers, transactions, subscriptions, and webhooks for checkout and recurring billing.

auth.details: Bearer token (API key) in Authorization header; sandbox and live keys from Paddle dashboard

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: 240 requests/minute per IP for most operations; 1,000 requests/minute for pricing-preview endpoints; immediate-charge subscription updates limited to 20/hour and 100/24 hours per subscription
use_cases: list products and prices for a Paddle catalog
create a customer and transaction for checkout
manage subscription status and billing cycle
verify webhook signatures for payment events

apis.name: PagerDuty API
apis.tagline: REST API for incidents, services, schedules, and on-call automation
apis.description: PagerDuty provides a REST API for managing incidents, services, escalation policies, schedules, and users. Developers use it to open and resolve incidents, query on-call rotations, automate response workflows, and integrate alerting into custom tooling and CI/CD systems.

auth.details: API key or OAuth 2.0 access token via Authorization: Token token=YOUR_API_KEY (or Bearer for OAuth). For certain requests using an account-level API key, include From: user@example.com. This is generally unnecessary for user-level keys.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available for small teams; API rate limits apply separately (see rate_limits). Exact free API request quotas not clearly published as a simple daily cap.
pricing.paid_plans: Professional, Business, and Enterprise plans with per-user pricing; details on pagerduty.com/pricing

apis.rate_limits: Generally 960 requests/minute per account API key, per user for user API keys, or per applicable OAuth app/user/account context; endpoint-specific exceptions may apply.
use_cases: list open incidents for a service
create an incident from a monitoring alert
get who is currently on-call for a schedule
acknowledge or resolve an incident by ID
list escalation policies and services
add a note to an incident during triage

apis.name: PandaScore
apis.tagline: Esports data API for scores, fixtures, and stats across major titles
apis.description: PandaScore provides real-time and historical esports data including live scores, match schedules, player and team stats, and tournament information for League of Legends, Counter-Strike, Dota 2, Valorant, and other competitive games via a REST API.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Bearer header or token query parameter; self-serve signup at app.pandascore.co

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 1,000 requests/hour
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans for higher rate limits and premium data access

apis.rate_limits: Free: 1,000 req/hour; paid plans have higher per-plan limits (see pricing)
use_cases: get upcoming esports matches for a game
fetch live match scores and status
list tournament brackets and schedules
get player or team statistics
search teams and players by name

apis.name: Particle
apis.tagline: Cloud platform for fleets of IoT devices with REST, OTA, and remote functions
apis.description: Particle provides a mature IoT device cloud with REST APIs for fleet management, OTA firmware updates, device variables and functions, events, and product/device provisioning. Developers use access tokens to call endpoints for listing devices, reading variables, calling remote functions, publishing events, and managing products at scale.

auth.details: OAuth access token (Bearer or access_token query/form param); create tokens in console or via OAuth. Product APIs also use product-scoped tokens.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Up to 100 devices (cellular or Wi-Fi), 100,000 Data Operations per month pooled across all devices, and up to 100 MB of pooled cellular data per month.

apis.rate_limits: 10,000 requests per 5 minutes per source IP for all API routes; selected token, account, and event routes: 100 per 5 minutes; SSE: 100 simultaneous connections per source IP; serial-number lookup: 50 per hour per access-token user account.
use_cases: list devices in a Particle account or product fleet
read a device cloud variable by name
call a remote function on a connected device
publish or subscribe to Particle device events
trigger or monitor OTA firmware updates for a fleet

apis.name: VisaList Passport Index API
apis.tagline: Visa-free access and passport ranking data for destination eligibility.
apis.description: Passport Index API provides request-based access to real-time visa-policy and visa-free-list data for every country. Its data is sourced from government agencies and updated in real time, with government agencies prioritized for API access.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header, self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1,000 req/day free
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available

apis.rate_limits: 1,000 req/day free, paid plans have higher limits
use_cases: get current weather for a city
check visa requirements for a passport
get passport ranking data
list visa-free countries for a passport

apis.name: PayPal REST API
apis.tagline: Accept payments, issue refunds, and manage orders via PayPal's REST APIs.
apis.description: PayPal's REST APIs let developers accept online payments, create and capture orders, manage subscriptions, handle refunds, and integrate checkout for web and mobile apps. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials (Client ID and Secret) against sandbox or live endpoints. Core payment flows center on the Orders and Payments APIs, with additional products for invoicing, payouts, and webhooks.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 client credentials: POST client_id:client_secret to /v1/oauth2/token for a Bearer access token. Sandbox: api-m.sandbox.paypal.com. Self-serve app creation in the Developer Dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access is free; PayPal charges per transaction (standard merchant rates). Sandbox is free for testing. Exact fee schedule varies by country and product.
pricing.paid_plans: Transaction-based merchant fees (e.g. typical US card rates ~2.99% + fixed fee); no separate API subscription. See PayPal merchant fees for current rates.

apis.rate_limits: not published as a single global limit; some products document per-endpoint limits. 429 responses indicate throttling.
use_cases: create a PayPal checkout order for a cart total
capture payment after buyer approval
refund a completed PayPal capture
list or get order details by order ID
set up a recurring subscription plan
verify webhook signatures for payment events

apis.name: Paystack API
apis.tagline: African payments API for cards, bank transfers, and mobile money
apis.description: Paystack is a payment gateway popular across Africa that lets businesses accept card, bank transfer, USSD, and mobile money payments. Its REST API covers charge initialization, verification, customers, transfers, subscriptions, and settlements, with sandbox keys for testing and production keys for live traffic.

auth.details: Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_KEY (secret key from dashboard). Public key used client-side for Paystack Inline/JS.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No monthly platform fee; pay per successful transaction (rates vary by country/channel). Test mode free with test keys.
pricing.paid_plans: Transaction fees only (e.g. Nigeria cards often ~1.5% + cap); no fixed subscription required for standard API access.

apis.rate_limits: Most endpoints: 600 requests per 60 seconds in live mode and 100 per 60 seconds in test mode, per integration and endpoint. Specified live-mode endpoints have extended limits of 900–3,000 requests per 60 seconds; test mode retains standard limits.
use_cases: initialize a payment for an order amount and email
verify a transaction by reference after checkout
list or create customers for recurring billing
initiate a bank transfer payout to a recipient
charge a saved authorization for subscription renewal

apis.name: PayU API
apis.tagline: CEE and global payments with cards and local methods
apis.description: PayU provides a payment gateway API for card processing, local payment methods, and multi-market checkout across Central and Eastern Europe and other regions. Merchants create orders, process payments, and manage refunds via REST endpoints.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant; access token used as Bearer token

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: create a payment order for checkout
authorize OAuth access token for merchant API
capture or refund a completed payment
list available payment methods for a market

apis.name: PDF.co
apis.tagline: PDF generation, editing, OCR, barcode, and document conversion REST API suite.
apis.description: PDF.co is a cloud REST API platform for generating, editing, converting, and processing PDF and other documents. Developers use it for PDF creation from HTML/templates, merge/split, OCR text extraction, barcode reading/generation, and format conversion via authenticated HTTPS endpoints.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header (or query string); self-serve signup at app.pdf.co.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 10,000 credits for a 1-month free trial; no credit card required.

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: convert HTML to PDF
merge multiple PDFs
OCR extract text from PDF
generate barcode image
convert PDF to images

apis.name: PDFShift
apis.tagline: HTML-to-PDF conversion API with CSS, headers/footers, and sandbox free usage
apis.description: PDFShift converts HTML (or URLs) to PDF via a simple REST API. It supports CSS, headers/footers, sandbox free usage, and various PDF options for generating documents programmatically.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth or X-API-Key header after self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 50 credits/month; 1 credit per 5 MB of generated output; 15 MB maximum file size; 30-second timeout. Sandbox conversions do not consume credits, include a watermark, and are limited to 10 documents/minute.

apis.rate_limits: 2 requests/minute when unauthenticated; up to 250 documents/minute when authenticated; 10 documents/minute in sandbox mode.

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.pdfshift.io/v3/convert/pdf -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"source": "https://example.com"}' --output document.pdf
example.response_snippet: Binary PDF content (or JSON with base64 when encode is true)

use_cases: convert HTML string to PDF
convert a web page URL to PDF
generate PDF invoices with custom headers/footers
sandbox-test PDF generation without a paid plan

apis.name: Pelias
apis.tagline: Open-source geocoding API for address search, reverse geocoding, and place autocomplete.
apis.description: Pelias is an open-source geocoding engine exposed via Geocode Earth's hosted API (api.geocode.earth). It turns free-text addresses and place names into structured geographic coordinates, supports reverse geocoding, and offers autocomplete-style search for maps and location apps.

auth.details: API key via the api_key query parameter; self-serve signup through Geocode Earth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No permanent free tier; two-week free trial with no credit card required.
pricing.paid_plans: Lite $100/mo (150k req, ≤10 rps); Basic $200/mo (400k, ≤10 rps); Advanced $500/mo (2M, ≤20 rps); Custom for higher volume.

apis.rate_limits: Plan-dependent: hard per-second limits (Lite/Basic up to 10 rps, Advanced up to 20 rps); trial plans also have hard per-day limits; all plans have soft monthly request allowances.

example.response_snippet: {"geocoding":{"version":"0.2","attribution":"https://geocode.earth/guidelines","query":{"text":"30 West 26th Street, New York, NY","size":10}},"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-73.9897,40.7441]},"properties":{"id":"openaddresses:address:us/ny/city_of_new_york:...","gid":"openaddresses:address:us/ny/city_of_new_york:...","layer":"address","source":"openaddresses","name":"30 West 26th Street","housenumber":"30","street":"West 26th Street","postalcode":"10010","confidence":0.9,"label":"30 West 26th Street, New York, NY, USA"}}]}

use_cases: geocode a street address to lat/lon
reverse geocode coordinates to an address
autocomplete place names as a user types
find nearby places from a point
batch-normalize addresses for a dataset

apis.name: Perenual Plant API
apis.tagline: Plant species, care, and hardiness data for gardening apps
apis.description: REST API for plant species lists and details, care guides, hardiness maps, and searchable pest/disease listings. It exposes botanical data including growth, images, watering, and sunlight. A free Personal plan is available. The disease endpoint lists records; plant identification is a separate beta API.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (self-serve signup at perenual.com). Example: ?key=YOUR_API_KEY

pricing.free_tier_limits: Personal plan: 100 requests/day; Regular API; species data IDs 1-3000; hardiness maps and plant care guides/FAQ for species IDs 1-3000; plant disease API IDs 1-100.

apis.rate_limits: Daily request quotas: Personal 100; Premium 10,000; Supreme 100,000; Enterprise custom limits.
use_cases: list plant species with filters for watering and sunlight
get detailed care guide for a plant species by ID
look up hardiness zone suitability for a plant
search plants by common or scientific name

apis.name: Perigon
apis.tagline: Real-time news and web content API for developers
apis.description: Perigon provides a news and web content API that delivers real-time articles, headlines, and structured media data for applications that need current events coverage, media monitoring, or content intelligence.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter, Authorization: Bearer header, or x-api-key header; header authentication is recommended.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 150 API requests/mo, personal (non-commercial) license, all endpoints, 3 months historical data, real-time, 1 req/sec, max 25 results/request; no credit card

apis.rate_limits: Free: 1 req/sec; Basic: 2; Plus: 4; Commercial: custom (https://perigon.io/products/pricing/apis)
use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword
monitor headlines for a topic or company
fetch structured article metadata for media apps

apis.name: Perplexity API
apis.tagline: Search-grounded LLM API with real-time web results and citations
apis.description: Perplexity API provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions powered by Sonar models that ground answers in live web search with citations. Developers call a REST endpoint with an API key for grounded Q&A, research, and retrieval-augmented generation without managing their own search stack.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; create keys in Perplexity account settings (self-serve)

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: Tiered by cumulative spend (T0–T5). Sonar: 50 RPM at T0 → 4,000 RPM at T4–T5 (sonar-deep-research: 5→100 RPM). Agent API: 50/min (T0) → 2,000/min (T4–T5). Search API: 50 query units/sec (all tiers).

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"sonar","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the capital of France?"}]}'

use_cases: answer a factual question with live web grounding and citations
research a current topic and return sources
summarize recent news on a company or product
compare products using up-to-date web information

apis.name: Persona
apis.tagline: Identity verification and KYC/KYB API for compliance workflows
apis.description: Persona provides identity verification, KYC/KYB, and watchlist screening APIs for modern compliance workflows. Developers use it to verify individuals and businesses, run risk checks, and manage verification sessions programmatically.

auth.details: API key via Authorization Bearer header (self-serve signup)

pricing.free_tier_limits: No ongoing general free tier. The no-credit-card Essential trial lasts 60 days, includes up to 50 services, and is Sandbox-only by default; Production access requires additional information and business verification.

apis.rate_limits: Default production limit: 300 API requests per minute across all API keys in the environment. Additional product-specific creation quotas apply; exact limits are available in the Persona Dashboard and response headers.
use_cases: create identity verification inquiry for a user
retrieve inquiry status and verification results
run watchlist or sanctions screening
verify business (KYB) identity documents

apis.name: Personio
apis.tagline: European HR API for recruiting, employees, and absences
apis.description: Personio provides a REST API for European HR operations: employees, absences, attendance, recruiting, and documents. Developers integrate HRIS data into internal tools, payroll sync, and candidate workflows.

auth.details: OAuth2 client credentials or company-specific API credentials; verify current method in developer portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No ongoing free tier. Custom API access requires the paid Core Pro plan. Personio offers a one-time 14-day software trial, not an ongoing API free tier.

apis.rate_limits: v1 has a global limit of 2,000 requests/minute/IP. GET /v1/company/employees is limited to 300 requests/minute with a 15-requests/second burst. Other endpoint-specific limits may apply.
use_cases: list company employees
fetch employee absences
sync recruiting candidates
export attendance records

apis.name: Perspective API
apis.tagline: Toxicity and abuse scoring for online comments via ML models
apis.description: Google's Perspective API scores text for toxicity, severe toxicity, insult, threat, identity attack, and related attributes using machine learning models trained for content moderation. Developers send comment text and receive attribute probability scores for filtering, ranking, or flagging user-generated content.

auth.details: Google Cloud API key as query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY; enable the Perspective Comment Analyzer API in Google Cloud Console

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1 QPS free by default; higher free quotas available on request (see docs)
pricing.paid_plans: Contact for higher quotas; primarily free with request-based quota increases

apis.rate_limits: Default 1 query per second (QPS); higher limits available via quota request

example.request: curl -X POST 'https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze?key=YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"comment":{"text":"This is a test comment"},"languages":["en"],"requestedAttributes":{"TOXICITY":{}}}'

use_cases: score comment toxicity for moderation queues
flag identity attacks or threats in user posts
filter toxic chat messages before display
rank forum comments by toxicity score
batch-analyze UGC for community health dashboards

apis.name: Philips Hue
apis.tagline: Local and cloud CLIP v2 API for lights, rooms, scenes, and entertainment.
apis.description: Philips Hue is a smart lighting API that provides local and cloud CLIP v2 access for lights, rooms, scenes, and entertainment.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header, self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: No official 1,000-requests/day free-tier allowance is published; the remote API quota is 50,000 calls per day, without a published paid/free tier distinction.

apis.rate_limits: Remote API: 50,000 calls/day; overage may cause throttling or revocation. Local guidance: about 10 commands/second for lights and 1 command/second for groups.
use_cases: turn lights on or off
adjust light brightness and color
list rooms and their assigned lights
activate a saved lighting scene
start an entertainment lighting session

apis.name: PhishTank
apis.tagline: Community phishing URL verification feed for mail and browser protection
apis.description: PhishTank is a collaborative clearing house for phishing URL verification. Developers can check URLs against a community-maintained phishing database and consume data feeds for mail and browser protection.

auth.details: Optional API key via application parameter; higher rate limits with registered key from free signup at phishtank.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: check if a URL is a known phishing site
download phishing URL data feeds for bulk screening
verify reported phishing URLs before blocking
integrate phishing checks into email/browser security

apis.name: Photon
apis.tagline: Open-source OSM geocoder with autocomplete from Komoot
apis.description: Photon is an open-source geocoder started by Komoot and built for OpenStreetMap data using OpenSearch. It supports forward and reverse geocoding, search-as-you-type, a public demo at photon.komoot.io, and self-hosting.

auth.details: Public demo endpoint requires no authentication; self-hosted instances may add their own auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public demo is free with fair-use expectations; no published paid plans for the demo.

apis.rate_limits: not published for public demo; self-host for production load
use_cases: autocomplete place names as a user types
forward-geocode an address or place name to coordinates
reverse-geocode lat/lon to a place name
bias search results to a map viewport or location

apis.name: Pinecone Inference
apis.tagline: Managed embeddings and reranking via Pinecone Inference API
apis.description: Pinecone Inference provides managed embedding generation and reranking through the Pinecone API, letting developers convert text into vectors and rerank search results without running their own models. It integrates with Pinecone's vector database for RAG and semantic search pipelines.

auth.details: API key via Api-Key header (or Authorization Bearer); self-serve signup at app.pinecone.io

pricing.free_tier_limits: Starter includes 5,000,000 embedding tokens per month per model and 500 rerank requests per month for each of bge-reranker-v2-m3 and pinecone-rerank-v0.

apis.rate_limits: 100 inference requests per second and 2,000 per minute per project; embedding-token and rerank-request limits also vary by model and plan.

example.request: curl -X POST "https://api.pinecone.io/embed" -H "Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Pinecone-Api-Version: 2026-04" -d '{"model":"multilingual-e5-large","parameters":{"input_type":"query"},"inputs":[{"text":"What is the capital of France?"}]}'

use_cases: generate text embeddings for semantic search
rerank retrieval results for RAG
embed documents before upserting to a Pinecone index
batch-embed query strings for similarity search

apis.name: Pinterest
apis.tagline: Create, manage, and analyze Pins and boards via Pinterest's official developer platform.
apis.description: Pinterest's REST API lets developers create and manage Pins, boards, and ads; fetch user and catalog data; and run analytics for businesses. Access is via OAuth 2.0 apps in the Pinterest developer portal, with endpoints for organic content, advertising, and commerce use cases under published rate limits.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 access token in Authorization: Bearer header; register an app in the Pinterest developer portal (developers.pinterest.com).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Trial: 1,000 requests/day per app (universal) plus per-category daily caps (e.g. org_write/ads_write 300/day). Standard: 100 requests/second per user per app (universal) plus published per-category per-minute limits. No paid API usage tiers.

apis.rate_limits: Published. Universal: Trial 1,000 req/day all requests; Standard 100 req/sec per user per app. Plus per-category limits (e.g. org_read Standard 1,000/min, org_write 100/min, ads_analytics 300/min, ads_write 400/min, org_analytics 60/min). See official rate-limits table and response headers.
use_cases: get authenticated Pinterest user account profile
list boards for a connected Pinterest account
create a Pin on a board from an image URL
fetch Pin analytics for a business account
search Pins by keyword for content discovery

apis.name: Pirate Weather
apis.tagline: Dark Sky–compatible free weather API replacement
apis.description: Pirate Weather is a free weather API that provides a Dark Sky–compatible replacement after Apple shut down the Dark Sky API. It offers current conditions, forecasts, and historical weather data via a simple REST API.

auth.details: API key via path parameter in the URL (self-serve signup).

pricing.free_tier_limits: 10,000 API calls/month (free plan)
pricing.paid_plans: $2/month donation raises limit to 20,000 calls/month (docs); Apiable billing also lists paid tiers (e.g. ~$3/mo for 20k, higher for 60k)

apis.rate_limits: 10,000 calls/month free; 20,000 calls/month with the ~$2–3/month supporter option; monthly quota in Ratelimit-* response headers; per-key throttle ~1–4 req/s by plan
use_cases: get current weather for a location
get hourly and daily weather forecasts
get historical weather data for a location

apis.name: TVmaze
apis.tagline: Free TV show, episode, and schedule data API with no authentication required
apis.description: TVmaze provides a free, public REST API for TV show metadata: search by name, full show details, episode lists and air dates, cast and crew, network schedules, and people credits. No API key is required for standard access; responses are JSON. Widely used for media apps, episode trackers, and TV schedule tools.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public API. Optional API key support may exist for partners; standard developer access is unauthenticated HTTPS GET requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public endpoints with best-effort service. CC BY-SA permits any purpose, including commercial use, provided TVmaze is credited and ShareAlike is followed. Allows at least 20 calls per 10 seconds per IP.

apis.rate_limits: At least 20 calls every 10 seconds per IP address. Edge-cached requests may not count; temporary stricter limits may apply. Clients should back off and retry after HTTP 429.
use_cases: search TV shows by name and get primary match details
list all episodes for a show with air dates and numbers
get today's or a country's TV broadcast schedule
look up cast and crew for a show
resolve a show by IMDb or TVDB external ID
get person credits (acting/crew history) by people ID

apis.name: Plaid API
apis.tagline: Connect bank accounts, verify identity, and move money via financial APIs
apis.description: Plaid is a financial data platform that lets apps securely link bank accounts, fetch balances and transactions, verify identity and income, and initiate payments. Developers integrate via REST APIs with Link for account connection and product endpoints for data and money movement.

auth.details: Client ID and secret in JSON body (client_id, secret); product-specific access tokens after Link

pricing.free_tier_limits: Sandbox always free (simulated data). US/Canada Trial (new teams on/after 2026-04-15): free production data, max 10 Items, bundled core products.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go (no minimum/commitment, usage-based, up to ~$6k/mo); Growth; Custom/Scale (sales). Exact rates via Production access application.

apis.rate_limits: Endpoint-specific published limits. e.g. Production /accounts/get: 15 req/min per Item, 15,000/min per client (Sandbox: 100/min Item, 5,000/min client). See docs rate-limit table.
use_cases: link a user's bank account
fetch account balances
list recent transactions
verify bank account ownership
initiate ACH payments

apis.name: Plant.id (Kindwise)
apis.tagline: Image-based plant identification and disease diagnosis API for apps
apis.description: Plant.id by Kindwise is a computer-vision API that identifies plants, weeds, and diseases from photos. Developers send plant images and receive species suggestions with confidence scores, taxonomy, common names, and optional health/disease assessment. Widely used in gardening, farming, and agtech apps for field identification and crop health checks.

auth.details: API key via Api-Key header (or api_key query param in some endpoints); self-serve signup on web.plant.id

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 free testing credits after registration. Each successful identification costs 1 credit; including plant.health in the same request costs 1 additional credit.

example.response_snippet: {"rent":1620,"rentRangeLow":1550,"rentRangeHigh":1690,"subjectProperty":{"formattedAddress":"5500 Grand Lake Dr, San Antonio, TX 78244","propertyType":"Single Family","bedrooms":3,"bathrooms":2,"squareFootage":1878},"comparables":[{"formattedAddress":"7306 Kingsland Dr, San Antonio, TX 78244","price":1627,"correlation":0.9873}]}

get home value AVM estimate for a property
look up property record attributes, owner, tax, and sale history by address
search active sale or rental listings in a city or area
fetch zip-code market statistics and historical rent/price trends

apis.name: Replicate
apis.tagline: Run open-source and commercial AI models via a simple HTTP API

Developers can generate images, run language models, transcribe audio, and more by calling model endpoints with inputs; many popular open-source models are available without self-hosting. Authentication uses a personal API token; billing is typically usage-based by model compute.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN header; create tokens in account settings after signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Select models can be run free for limited usage; Replicate eventually requires billing setup, and no fixed free-credit amount is promised.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go by model runtime/compute; some models have per-second or per-output pricing

apis.rate_limits: Default: 600 prediction-creation requests/minute and 3,000 requests/minute for other endpoints; accounts with low/granted credit and no payment method may get stricter limits.

example.request:
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Prefer: wait" \
  -d '{"input": {"prompt": "a sunset over mountains"}}' \
  https://api.replicate.com/v1/models/black-forest-labs/flux-schnell/predictions

use_cases: generate an image from a text prompt with Flux or SDXL
run an open-source LLM inference call without self-hosting
transcribe audio with Whisper or similar hosted models
upscale or edit an image with a community model
create embeddings or run vision models via hosted endpoints
