apis.tagline: SODA access to City of Seattle open datasets via data.seattle.gov
apis.description: The City of Seattle publishes open government datasets on data.seattle.gov, accessible through Socrata's SODA REST API. Developers can query hundreds of municipal datasets (crime, 911, permits, transportation, budgets, and more) as JSON, CSV, or other formats using SoQL filters, without scraping the portal UI.

auth.details: Optional app token via X-App-Token header (or $$app_token query param); unauthenticated access allowed with stricter throttling. App tokens obtained from Socrata developer portal after signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public SODA 2.1 reads are free. Anonymous requests use a lower shared IP-based pool; app-token requests have no fixed cap and are throttled only for abusive or malicious use. No numeric anonymous threshold is published.

apis.rate_limits: Anonymous requests may be throttled mainly by source IP. App-token requests are currently unthrottled unless abusive or malicious. Throttling returns HTTP 429; no numeric threshold is published.
use_cases: query recent Seattle 911 or crime incidents by date and neighborhood
pull building permit applications for a Seattle address or district
list Seattle traffic camera or transportation dataset rows with SoQL filters
export Seattle budget or city department open data as JSON for analysis

apis.name: SEC EDGAR
apis.tagline: Official US SEC filings and company facts APIs for 10-K/10-Q, XBRL, and insider data
apis.description: Public REST APIs from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission providing JSON company submission histories and extracted XBRL data, including company facts, company concepts, and reporting-period frames. No API key is required; automated access must follow the SEC's fair-access policy.

auth.details: No API key or OAuth. Requests must include a descriptive User-Agent identifying the application and a contact email (e.g. SampleCompany name@samplecompany.com). Undeclared or blocked User-Agents may be denied.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public data; fair access ~10 requests/second

apis.rate_limits: Fair access: max 10 requests per second across data.sec.gov and related EDGAR hosts; higher rates risk temporary blocks
use_cases: fetch a company's recent SEC form filings by CIK
look up XBRL company facts and financial tags for a filer
get company submissions history and filing metadata
search EDGAR full-text for keywords in filings
retrieve insider transaction (Form 4) related filing lists

apis.name: SecurityTrails
apis.tagline: Historical DNS, WHOIS, and domain intelligence for recon and threat hunting.
apis.description: SecurityTrails API provides historical DNS records, WHOIS data, subdomain discovery, IP intelligence, and domain surface mapping for security research, threat hunting, and attack-surface analysis.

auth.details: API key via APIKEY header (or apikey as discouraged query-string fallback); self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: look up current DNS for a domain
enumerate historical DNS changes for a domain
discover subdomains for a domain
get WHOIS history for a domain
find domains associated with an IP
enrich a hostname for threat hunting

apis.name: Semantic Scholar
apis.tagline: Academic paper search and citation graph API
apis.description: Semantic Scholar provides a free academic knowledge graph API for searching papers, authors, citations, and related research. It powers paper discovery, citation analysis, and scholarly metadata access across science and technology domains.

auth.details: Optional API key via x-api-key header; unauthenticated access allowed with lower rate limits

pricing.free_tier_limits: Shared free tier: unauthenticated ~1,000 RPS shared pool (with possible additional throttling); free API key grants introductory individual limit of ~1 RPS; higher/partner limits via application/review

apis.rate_limits: Unauthenticated: ~1,000 RPS shared across all unauthenticated users, with possible additional throttling. API key: introductory individual limit of 1 RPS across endpoints; higher limits may be granted after review.
use_cases: search academic papers by keyword
fetch citation graph for a paper
look up author publication history
get paper abstracts and metadata

apis.name: Semaphore CI API
apis.tagline: CI/CD API for projects, pipelines, promotions, and secrets with monorepo support
apis.description: Semaphore provides a REST API for managing CI/CD projects, pipelines, promotions, secrets, and related resources. The API enables automation of builds, deployments, and monorepo workflows. Authentication uses API tokens. Docs and pricing should be verified from official sources for current endpoints, free-tier limits, and rate limits.

auth.details: API token authentication; verify exact header/scheme from current docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: $15 in free credits each month (≈2,000 Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minutes); 20 concurrent jobs by default; artifacts free up to 20 GB/month egress and 100 GB/month storage; 9.6 GB cache storage per project.

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.request: curl -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN" -H "User-Agent: SemaphoreCI v2.0 Client" -H "Accept: application/json" "https://YOUR_ORG.semaphoreci.com/api/v1alpha/pipelines?project_id=PROJECT_ID"

use_cases: list projects and pipelines
trigger pipeline runs
manage secrets
inspect promotions

apis.name: SendGrid
apis.tagline: Email delivery API for transactional and marketing messages
apis.description: SendGrid is Twilio’s email platform API for sending transactional and marketing email at scale. Developers authenticate with API keys, use a REST API (and SMTP) to send mail, manage contacts/templates, and track delivery events via webhooks. Widely used for app notifications, password resets, and bulk campaigns.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header; keys created in SendGrid dashboard (Settings → API Keys).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan historically allowed limited daily email sends; verify current Twilio SendGrid pricing for exact free-tier volume.
pricing.paid_plans: Essentials, Pro, Premier, and Marketing Campaigns plans billed by email volume; see Twilio SendGrid pricing.

apis.rate_limits: Varies by endpoint and plan; many mail-send endpoints document rate limits in response headers (X-RateLimit-*). Check docs for per-endpoint limits.

example.request: curl -X POST "https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"personalizations":[{"to":[{"email":"recipient@example.com"}]}],"from":{"email":"sender@example.com"},"subject":"Hello","content":[{"type":"text/plain","value":"Hello from SendGrid"}]}'
example.response_snippet: HTTP 202 Accepted (empty body on success for mail/send); errors return JSON like {"errors":[{"message":"...","field":null,"help":null}]}

use_cases: send transactional email (password reset, receipt)
send bulk marketing campaign email
validate email address deliverability
manage dynamic email templates
track bounces, opens, and clicks via event webhook
manage contact lists and suppression groups

apis.name: Sentry API
apis.tagline: Programmatic access to Sentry error monitoring, issues, projects, and releases.
apis.description: REST API for Sentry's error monitoring platform. Manage organizations, projects, issues, events, releases, and alert rules. Authenticate with auth tokens. Supports SaaS (sentry.io) and self-hosted instances. Used to automate issue triage, release tracking, and monitoring integrations.

auth.details: Bearer token via Authorization header (auth tokens from User Settings > Auth Tokens, or organization tokens). Scopes control access. Also supports session cookies for browser sessions.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list unresolved issues for a project
create a release and attach commits
fetch error event details by ID
update issue status or assign ownership
list projects in an organization

apis.name: SEPTA API
apis.tagline: Real-time and schedule data for Philadelphia regional transit
apis.description: Public SEPTA developer APIs for Regional Rail arrivals, TrainView, Next-to-Arrive, and schedules; bus and trolley locations, detours, schedules, and stops; service alerts, elevator outages, and GTFS/GTFS-RT feeds. The documentation does not claim uniform real-time vehicle coverage for subway/elevated lines.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints are openly accessible without API keys or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unlimited free public access; no published quotas

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: get next regional rail arrivals for a SEPTA station
track live bus or trolley vehicle locations on a route
look up train schedule between two regional rail stations
fetch current SEPTA service alerts and detours
get real-time train positions on the regional rail network

apis.name: SerpApi
apis.tagline: Real-time Google and multi-engine SERP results as structured JSON.
apis.description: SerpApi scrapes and parses search engine results pages (Google and 80+ other engines) into structured JSON. It handles proxies, captchas, and rich SERP features so developers can query organic results, ads, knowledge panels, and local packs without building scrapers.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (self-serve signup; key at serpapi.com/manage-api-key).

pricing.free_tier_limits: 250 searches/month on Free plan (per current pricing); check serpapi.com/pricing for throughput
pricing.paid_plans: Developer ~$75/mo (5k searches); Production $150/mo (15k); higher tiers scale to 100k+; Enterprise available

apis.rate_limits: Free plan: documented as 50 searches/hour throughput on older sources; verify current plan table on serpapi.com/pricing for exact hourly limits
use_cases: get Google organic SERP results for a keyword as JSON
check local pack / maps results for a business query
monitor ranking positions for SEO keywords over time
fetch Google Scholar or other engine results via engine parameter
power an agent with live web search snippets

apis.name: SF Open Data API
apis.tagline: Socrata SODA API for San Francisco open datasets and civic applications
apis.description: San Francisco's official open-data portal provides hundreds of city datasets through Socrata SODA, including tabular and geospatial civic data. Public SODA 2.1 resource reads require no authentication; an optional app token identifies the application and provides higher throttling limits. SODA 3 queries require an app token or user authentication.

auth.details: Optional app token via X-App-Token header (or app_token query param); unauthenticated access allowed at lower limits. Register an app on the portal for a token.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public SODA 2.1 reads are free. No fixed numeric cap is published; app-token requests are currently unthrottled unless abusive or malicious, while anonymous requests use a lower shared-IP throttling pool.

apis.rate_limits: No fixed numeric limit is published. App-token requests are currently unthrottled except for abusive or malicious use; anonymous requests may be throttled by source IP. Throttling returns HTTP 429.
use_cases: query SF crime incidents by neighborhood and date
list recent building permits for a parcel or address
fetch city budget or department spending tables
get geospatial datasets for maps and civic apps

apis.name: ShipEngine
apis.tagline: Multi-carrier shipping rates, labels, and tracking API for developers.
apis.description: ShipEngine is a multi-carrier shipping API that provides rates, label generation, tracking, address validation, and carrier connections for e-commerce and logistics applications. It abstracts many carriers behind a unified REST API with JSON responses.

auth.details: API key via API-Key header; obtain from dashboard after self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: $0 plan: sandbox + essential API ops with ShipStation-provided carrier accounts, no API usage charge; own carrier accounts/full features need Advanced. Separate 30-day sandbox-only trial if no payment method.
pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based and volume plans; see shipengine.com/pricing

apis.rate_limits: 200 requests/minute by default; sandbox 20 requests/minute; higher limits may be requested.
use_cases: get multi-carrier shipping rates for a package
create a shipping label for a shipment
track a package by tracking number
validate a shipping address
list connected carrier accounts

apis.name: Shippo
apis.tagline: Multi-carrier shipping labels, rates, tracking, and address validation via one API.
apis.description: Shippo is a multi-carrier shipping platform API that lets apps get live rates, buy and print labels, track packages, validate addresses, and manage returns across carriers such as USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL. Developers authenticate with API tokens (test and live), use a free starter tier for label volume, and integrate via a REST JSON API with official SDKs for common languages.

auth.details: Shippo API token as Authorization: ShippoToken YOUR_API_KEY (test and live tokens from the dashboard after self-serve signup).

pricing.free_tier_limits: API Starter (Free): 30 labels/month free, then 7¢/label; no monthly platform fee. Standalone fees: tracking 2¢/track, rating 1¢/rate, US address validation 2¢, non-US 8¢ (see pricing/api).
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go and higher volume plans with discounted platform fees per label; enterprise options available.

apis.rate_limits: Per-minute by endpoint (official docs). Most core resources: POST/PUT 500 live/50 test; GET single 4,000/400; GET list 50/10. Tracking: POST 750/50, GET 500/50. Batch lower (e.g. POST 50/10). Exceeding returns 429.

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.goshippo.com/tracks/ -H "Authorization: ShippoToken YOUR_API_KEY" -d carrier="usps" -d tracking_number="9205590164917312751089"
example.response_snippet: {"carrier":"usps","tracking_number":"9205590164917312751089","tracking_status":{"status":"DELIVERED","status_details":"Your shipment has been delivered at the destination mailbox.","status_date":"2023-07-23T13:03:00Z"},"tracking_history":[{"status":"TRANSIT","status_details":"Your shipment has been accepted."}]}

use_cases: get live multi-carrier shipping rates for a package
buy and download a shipping label PDF
track a package by carrier and tracking number
validate and standardize a shipping address
create a multi-piece shipment and purchase labels

apis.name: Shodan
apis.tagline: Internet-wide search engine for exposed devices, services, and banners.
apis.description: Shodan is an internet-wide search engine that indexes banners and metadata from exposed devices and services. Its REST API lets developers query hosts, search by filters, look up DNS and ports, stream data, and manage scans—used for attack-surface discovery, asset inventory, and vulnerability research.

auth.details: API key via query parameter `key` (e.g. ?key=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve at account.shodan.io. Some clients also accept key in headers depending on client library.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 0 API query credits (no REST API access). Membership (paid) required for API query credits; higher plans add filters, streaming, and scan credits—see shodan.io/pricing and account plan.
pricing.paid_plans: Membership and enterprise plans with higher query credits, filters, and streaming; see shodan.io/pricing

apis.rate_limits: Plan-dependent; published limits tied to query credits and scan credits—see developer docs and account plan.
use_cases: look up open ports and banners for a specific IP
search the internet for devices matching a service or product filter
resolve hostnames and reverse DNS for exposed assets
check which services are exposed on a target network range
monitor for newly indexed devices matching a query

apis.name: Shopify Admin API
apis.tagline: Manage products, orders, customers, inventory, and store data via REST or GraphQL.
apis.description: Shopify Admin API lets apps and integrations manage a merchant's store: products, inventory, orders, customers, fulfillments, discounts, and more. GraphQL Admin is the primary/current interface; REST Admin is legacy (as of Oct 1, 2024). Since April 1, 2025, new public App Store apps must use GraphQL exclusively. REST remains for some existing/custom-app cases. OAuth for public apps; access tokens for custom apps. Shop-specific HTTPS endpoints.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 for public/custom apps (Bearer access token); custom apps also use Admin API access tokens from the Shopify admin. Scopes required per resource.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with Shopify store plans; Partner/dev stores free. No per-request API fee for standard Admin API usage — store subscription required.
pricing.paid_plans: Shopify store plans (Basic and up); app billing via Shopify Billing API optional for public apps.

apis.rate_limits: REST: 2 req/s bucket (leaky); GraphQL: cost-based (points/sec). Plus plans higher. Exact limits vary by plan and version — see docs.

example.request: curl -X POST "https://YOUR_SHOP.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/graphql.json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Shopify-Access-Token: YOUR_API_KEY" -d '{"query":"{ products(first: 1) { edges { node { id title } } } }"}'

use_cases: list products and variants for a Shopify store
create or update orders and fulfillments
sync inventory quantities across locations
fetch customers and order history for CRM integration
manage discounts, price rules, or gift cards
subscribe to webhooks for order/product changes

apis.name: SIMBAD
apis.tagline: Query the CDS astronomical object database for stars, galaxies, and identifiers.
apis.description: SIMBAD is the CDS astronomical object database API for looking up celestial objects by name or coordinates, resolving identifiers, and retrieving basic astrophysical data such as positions, magnitudes, spectral types, and bibliographic links. It is widely used for name resolution, cross-matching, and enriching catalogs in astronomy software and research pipelines.

auth.details: No authentication required for public script and URL query interfaces; heavy or automated use should follow CDS usage guidelines.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public free access; no published paid tiers. Heavy automated use should respect CDS fair-use guidance.

apis.rate_limits: not published as hard numeric quotas; CDS requests responsible automated access and may throttle abusive traffic

example.response_snippet:
Object M31 ---
Type: Galaxy
ICRS coord. (ep=J2000): 00 42 44.330 +41 16 07.50
...

use_cases: resolve an astronomical object name to coordinates
look up basic properties of a star or galaxy by identifier
batch-query identifiers from a catalog via SIMBAD script interface
cross-check alternate names and bibliographic references for an object

apis.name: Skyscanner Flights Live Prices
apis.tagline: Live flight price search for comparison and booking flows.
apis.description: Skyscanner's Flights Live Prices API provides real-time flight search results including itineraries, prices, carriers, and booking options for comparison shopping and travel applications.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header after partner signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: No monetary or usage-based free-tier quota is published. Approved commercial partners pay no booking, monthly, or yearly fees and operate under revenue share; per-key rate limits still apply.

apis.rate_limits: Default Flights Live Pricing limits: create 100 requests/second and 100/minute; poll 100/second and 500/minute. Actual limits are customized per API key and may differ under partner agreements.
use_cases: search live one-way flight prices between airports
compare multi-city flight itinerary prices
poll a live flight search session for complete results
get carrier and agent details for booking deep links

apis.name: Slack
apis.tagline: Workspace messaging API for chat, files, channels, and apps
apis.description: string

auth.details: Bot/user tokens via OAuth 2.0 (Bearer Authorization header); also legacy tokens and signing secrets for Events API

pricing.free_tier_limits: string

apis.rate_limits: string
use_cases: post a message to a channel
list channels in a workspace

apis.name: SmartRecruiters
apis.tagline: Enterprise talent acquisition REST API for jobs, candidates, and hiring workflows
apis.description: SmartRecruiters provides a mature public REST API for its enterprise talent acquisition platform. Developers can programmatically manage jobs, candidates, applications, and related hiring data. Authentication uses API keys; docs and endpoint details should be verified against current official sources before production use.

auth.details: API key authentication; exact header and signup flow to be confirmed from official docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: Not applicable; no free plan is currently listed.

apis.rate_limits: Customer API: 10 requests/second and 8 concurrent requests per API user. Exceptions: job-publication POST/DELETE endpoints allow 2 requests/second; GET /candidates and the deprecated Analytics API allow 1 concurrent request.
use_cases: list open jobs from a SmartRecruiters company account
fetch candidate application details by ID
create or update job postings programmatically
sync hiring pipeline data into an ATS or HRIS
search candidates matching role criteria

apis.name: SmartThings
apis.tagline: Samsung smart-home cloud REST API for devices, locations, scenes, and rules
apis.description: SmartThings is Samsung's smart-home platform API for managing devices, locations, rooms, scenes, and automation rules. Resource requests use OAuth 2.0 bearer access tokens. Short-lived personal access tokens are intended for testing and personal use; long-term production integrations use the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow to obtain access and refresh tokens. App client credentials participate in that flow but do not directly authenticate resource requests.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token (Personal Access Token or installed-app token) in Authorization header; create PATs at developer.smartthings.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: Published and endpoint-specific. Limits vary by operation; responses include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers, and exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429.
use_cases: list devices in a SmartThings location
read device capability status (switch, temperature, lock)
execute a device command (turn on/off, set level)
run a scene by scene ID
list locations and rooms for an account

apis.name: Smithsonian Open Access
apis.tagline: Search Smithsonian museum collections and open-access media.
apis.description: Public API for searching Smithsonian museum collections and open-access media across SI units. Developers can query object metadata, images, and related resources from the Smithsonian Institution's digitized collections.

auth.details: API key required; register at https://api.data.gov/signup/ and pass it as api_key (or the supported X-Api-Key header).

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: api.data.gov default: 1,000 requests/hour per API key (agency override possible). DEMO_KEY: 30 req/IP/hour and 50/IP/day. Check X-RateLimit-* response headers for effective limits.
use_cases: search Smithsonian museum object metadata by keyword
retrieve open-access images and media for a collection object
look up records across Smithsonian units (museums, archives, libraries)
fetch structured collection data for education or research apps

apis.name: Snipcart API
apis.tagline: Headless ecommerce cart and checkout API for custom storefronts
apis.description: Snipcart provides a REST API for managing carts, products, orders, customers, discounts, and inventory on its hosted ecommerce platform. Developers embed Snipcart on any site and use the Dashboard API with secret keys for server-side operations such as listing orders, updating products, and managing inventory. Public and private API keys support client-side cart flows and authenticated backend access.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth: Secret API key as username, empty password (Authorization: Basic base64(SECRET_KEY:)). Keys from Snipcart dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available for testing/development; transaction fees apply on paid plans (verify current tiers on snipcart.com/pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: 2% of transactions + payment gateway fees; if monthly sales are under $1,000 USD, the 2% is replaced by a $20 USD monthly fee (see snipcart.com/pricing)

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list and filter store orders for fulfillment
create or update products and inventory via API
manage customers and abandoned carts
apply discounts and promotional codes programmatically
fetch order details for custom admin dashboards

apis.name: Snyk
apis.tagline: Developer-first vulnerability scanning for dependencies, containers, and infrastructure as code
apis.description: Snyk provides REST and legacy APIs for vulnerability scanning of open-source dependencies, containers, and IaC. Developers authenticate with personal or service-account tokens to list organizations/projects, pull vulnerability findings, and integrate security checks into CI/CD and agent workflows.

auth.details: Bearer token (personal API token or service account) via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan for individuals (limited tests/projects; exact API quotas not published on public pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: Team and Enterprise plans with higher limits and org features; see snyk.io/plans

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list organizations and projects for a Snyk account
fetch open-source dependency vulnerability findings for a project
check container image issues via Snyk API
retrieve IaC security findings for scanned infrastructure
integrate vulnerability data into CI/CD or coding-agent workflows

apis.name: Socrata Open Data
apis.tagline: Open data platform for government and city datasets via SODA API
apis.description: Socrata (now part of Tyler Technologies) provides SODA (Socrata Open Data API) for querying city, state, and government open datasets. Developers access tabular data via REST endpoints with SoQL filtering, used widely for municipal open data portals.

auth.details: Optional X-App-Token (header preferred; $$app_token query) for higher throttling; OAuth/credentials for protected/write ops. Public reads need no auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: query city open data
filter government datasets with SoQL

apis.name: SoilGrids
apis.tagline: Global soil property maps via REST for precision-ag planning
apis.description: SoilGrids is ISRIC's global digital soil-mapping system, providing modeled soil-property maps at 250 m resolution across six standard depth intervals, with quantified prediction uncertainty. Its beta REST API v2.0 is currently paused with no estimated restoration date; ISRIC recommends WMS, WCS, WebDAV, or Google Earth Engine for current access.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public REST endpoints; requests are made directly without API keys or OAuth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0, but the REST API is currently paused. When available, fair use is limited to 5 API calls per 1-minute period.

apis.rate_limits: 5 API calls per 1-minute period under the Fair Use Policy; the REST API is currently paused.
use_cases: get soil pH at a farm field lat/lon
fetch clay/silt/sand texture fractions for a plot
retrieve soil organic carbon stock for a depth interval
sample bulk density and related properties for site suitability
batch-query soil layers for precision-ag planning polygons (via multiple point queries)

apis.name: Solar System OpenData
apis.tagline: Open REST API for planets, moons, and solar system body physical data
apis.description: Solar System OpenData (Le Système solaire) is a free public REST API that serves physical and orbital data for solar system bodies: planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and dwarf planets. Data includes mass, density, gravity, escape velocity, mean radius, semi-major axis, and related properties. Access remains free but requires a free Bearer token (generatekey.html); JSON over HTTPS.

auth.details: Free Bearer token required. Obtain at https://api.le-systeme-solaire.net/generatekey.html (active email). Send header: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY_GUID>.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: get physical properties for a planet by id
list all known moons of a planet
compare density and gravity across solar system bodies
fetch orbital parameters (semi-major axis, eccentricity) for a body
look up mean radius and escape velocity for educational apps

apis.name: Solcast
apis.tagline: High-accuracy solar irradiance and PV power forecasts via REST API
apis.description: Solcast provides high-accuracy solar irradiance and photovoltaic (PV) power forecast and live data via a REST API. Developers use it for solar resource assessment, short-term PV power forecasting, and grid/energy management applications. A free tier is available for limited API use.

auth.details: API key via query parameter or Authorization header; self-serve signup at Solcast Toolkit.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Evaluation: up to 15 Historic Time Series and 10 Live/Forecast requests at user locations; unlimited at unmetered locations. Researchers receive 50 free historical requests. Home hobbyists receive 10 requests/day for one residential site.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial plans available

apis.rate_limits: Enforced per API key and dependent on the subscription plan/product. Current limits are shown in the API Toolkit and response headers; exceeding a rate limit returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After.
use_cases: get live solar irradiance for a lat/lon
fetch PV power forecast for a site
retrieve historical solar radiation data
get satellite-based solar estimates

apis.name: SonarCloud
apis.tagline: Cloud code quality and security analysis for CI and pull requests
apis.description: SonarCloud is a SaaS static analysis platform from SonarSource for continuous inspection of code quality and security. Its REST API exposes projects, measures, issues, quality gates, and analysis status so teams can automate reporting, gate checks, and dashboards in CI/CD.

auth.details: User token via HTTP Basic: token as username, empty password (Authorization: Basic base64(token:)). Generate tokens under My Account → Security.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: private projects up to 50k LOC, max 5 org members, unlimited public projects (main branch only). Separate free OSS plan: unlimited public repos, no private projects.
pricing.paid_plans: Team (from ~$34/mo, 100k–1.9M private LOC, unlimited members) and Enterprise (custom/annual, unlimited LOC ideal from 5M LOC, SSO/SCIM, portfolios, etc.). Priced by private LOC analyzed, not API calls. See sonarsource.com/plans-and-pricing/sonarcloud/

apis.rate_limits: not published (standard web API; no public per-endpoint RPS table found)
use_cases: list SonarCloud projects for an organization
fetch quality gate status for a project analysis
get code coverage or maintainability measures for a component
search open issues (bugs, vulnerabilities, code smells) by project
check latest analysis status before merging a PR

apis.name: Sourcegraph API
apis.tagline: GraphQL API for code search, navigation, and repository intelligence across large codebases.
apis.description: Sourcegraph exposes a GraphQL API (and supporting REST/batch endpoints) for searching code, browsing repositories, resolving symbols, managing batch changes, and integrating with self-hosted or Sourcegraph.com instances. Developers typically authenticate with an access token and query the GraphQL schema for search results, file contents, and code intelligence data used by IDE extensions, bots, and automation.

auth.details: Personal access token via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY header (or Sourcegraph-Auth-Token); create tokens in user settings on Sourcegraph.com or self-hosted instances.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.request: curl -X POST 'https://sourcegraph.com/.api/graphql' -H 'Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"query { currentUser { username } }"}'

use_cases: search code across repositories with Sourcegraph query syntax
resolve symbol definitions and references in a large monorepo
fetch file contents and repository metadata for automation
run or inspect batch changes programmatically
list repositories and check indexing status for a Sourcegraph instance

apis.name: Spaceflight News API

apis.name: TaxJar API
apis.tagline: Sales tax calculation and reporting API for ecommerce platforms
apis.description: TaxJar provides a REST API for real-time sales tax calculations, tax rate lookups, nexus management, and automated sales tax reporting. Used by ecommerce platforms and marketplaces to determine tax rates by location, calculate order tax, and file returns across US jurisdictions.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Bearer header; obtain from TaxJar account dashboard after signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: No free production tier. Paid plans only (Starter from $39/mo without API; Professional from $99/mo with API). 30-day free trial available; developer sandbox is for testing only (not free production access).

apis.rate_limits: 10000 requests/min Professional; 25000 requests/min Premium; excess may get HTTP 429
use_cases: calculate sales tax for an ecommerce order by address
look up combined sales tax rate by ZIP code
list nexus regions for a merchant account
create a transaction for sales tax reporting
validate a customer address for tax purposes

apis.name: TCGDEX
apis.tagline: Multilingual Pokémon TCG API for sets, cards, and series.
apis.description: TCGDEX is a free and open multilingual Pokémon Trading Card Game API providing structured data on cards, sets, series, and related metadata for developers building tools, collectors apps, and game-related experiences.

auth.details: No authentication required; public open API endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: no published hard limits (be considerate; cache bulk data)

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: look up a Pokémon TCG card by ID or name
list cards in a set
fetch series and set metadata
build a multilingual card search tool

apis.name: TCGplayer API
apis.tagline: Marketplace product catalog and market pricing for Magic, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh, and more
apis.description: TCGplayer API provides access to product catalog data and market pricing for trading card games including Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and other TCGs. Developers can query products, categories, pricing, and marketplace information for building collection tools, price trackers, and inventory apps.

auth.details: unknown

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: get current market price for a Magic card
search Pokémon product catalog by name

apis.name: Telegram Bot API
apis.tagline: HTTPS Bot API for sending messages, media, and bot interactions on Telegram
apis.description: Official HTTP interface for Telegram bots: send and receive messages, media, keyboards, payments, Mini Apps, and updates via long polling or webhooks. Auth is a bot token from @BotFather placed in the request URL. The cloud API is free of charge; messaging is rate-limited, with optional paid higher-throughput broadcasts via Telegram Stars where offered.

auth.details: Bot token issued by @BotFather (self-serve in Telegram). Pass it in the URL path: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME. No Authorization header required for standard Bot API calls.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free unlimited API use (no call quotas or monthly fees). Free messaging subject to rate limits: ~1 msg/sec per private chat, 20 msg/min per group. Bulk free broadcast throughput and paid Stars broadcast rates are separate (see rate_limits).
pricing.paid_plans: Optional paid broadcasts (BotFather): up to 1000 msg/sec; 0.1 Telegram Stars per message over free 30/sec. Requires ≥100,000 Stars balance and ≥100,000 monthly active users.

apis.rate_limits: FAQ: ~1 message/sec per private chat; ≤20 messages/min per group; 429 on excess. Free bulk broadcast about 30 msg/sec; paid broadcasts (BotFather/Stars) can go higher when eligible. Other method limits not fully published.
use_cases: send a text message to a Telegram user or chat
poll getUpdates for new bot messages (long polling)
set or remove a webhook for bot updates
download a file users sent to the bot
send a photo, document, or location to a chat
verify bot token and identity with getMe

apis.name: Tenderly
apis.tagline: EVM simulation, debugging, and node RPC for apps and wallets
apis.description: Tenderly provides simulation, transaction debugging, Node RPC, Virtual Environments, and monitoring tools across supported blockchain networks. Developers use it to dry-run transactions, inspect traces, create stateful forks, query on-chain state, and monitor activity. REST API access uses personal-account or organization access tokens via X-Access-Key; many endpoints also identify account and project slugs.

auth.details: Access Token (API key) via X-Access-Key header; create in Dashboard → Account Settings → Authorization. Project slug and account username required in many path-based REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free indefinitely includes browser-based Explorer, full Debugger, and single-transaction UI simulation. The Free plan has no API access, and Node RPC is paid-only.
pricing.paid_plans: Pro and custom Enterprise plans with higher unit allowances for Node, Simulations, Alerts, and Virtual TestNets.

apis.rate_limits: No universal or plan-specific request-rate schedule is published. Node RPC is metered by per-method Tenderly Unit costs; account capacity and limits are arranged with sales.
use_cases: simulate an EVM transaction before sending it
debug a failed transaction with full call traces
get Node RPC / Web3 Gateway access for an EVM chain
fork a mainnet state into a Virtual TestNet for testing
monitor contracts and set transaction alerts

apis.name: Tenor
apis.tagline: Google-owned GIF and sticker search API for messaging apps
apis.description: Tenor provides a GIF, sticker, and media search API used by messaging and social apps. Developers can search, autocomplete, and retrieve trending content via a REST API with an API key. Owned by Google.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter; create in Google Cloud Console and enable Tenor API

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: search GIFs by keyword
get trending GIFs
autocomplete GIF search suggestions
fetch stickers for chat reactions

apis.name: Terraform Cloud API
apis.tagline: REST API for HCP Terraform workspaces, runs, state, and orgs.
apis.description: JSON:API for HCP Terraform (formerly Terraform Cloud) at app.terraform.io. Manage organizations, workspaces, runs, variables, state versions, and teams via Bearer tokens. Versioned under /api/v2 with Content-Type application/vnd.api+json. Free tier covers up to 500 managed resources; paid plans scale by resource under management.

auth.details: Bearer token (user, team, or organization) via Authorization: Bearer header. Create tokens in UI at app.terraform.io Settings → Tokens, or via Team/Organization Token APIs. Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Enhanced Free: up to 500 managed resources, 1 concurrent run, unlimited users (legacy Free EOL Mar 31 2026). API access included; not request-quota free.
pricing.paid_plans: Essentials ~$0.10, Standard ~$0.47, Premium ~$0.99 per managed resource/month (pay-as-you-go). Trial credits may apply for new orgs.

apis.rate_limits: Published: ~30 req/s per IP for most endpoints; some endpoints lower (e.g. run polling, auth). 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded. Check official API docs rate-limiting section.
use_cases: list organizations and workspaces for an account
trigger or poll a Terraform run on a workspace
read or upload Terraform state versions
manage workspace variables and variable sets
create team or organization API tokens programmatically

apis.name: Transport for London Unified API
apis.tagline: Live London tube, bus, rail, bike, and road status via one free REST API
apis.description: Transport for London's Unified API provides real-time and static data for London transport modes including Tube, bus, DLR, Overground, Elizabeth line, National Rail in London, river, cycle hire, roads, and disruptions. Developers register for a free Application ID and primary key, then call REST endpoints under api.tfl.gov.uk. Responses are primarily JSON (with XML options on some resources). The API is widely used for journey planning, line status, arrivals, and stop/point lookups.

auth.details: App ID and primary key from TfL API Portal; pass as query params app_id and app_key, or as headers (AppID/AppKey). Free self-serve registration.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for most non-commercial use with registration; commercial use may require agreement — confirm on portal

apis.rate_limits: Published fair-use style limits via portal; historically ~500 requests/min — verify current quota on api-portal.tfl.gov.uk
use_cases: get live Tube line status for all lines
fetch next bus arrivals at a stop
plan a journey between two London locations
list disruptions on roads or transport modes
get Santander Cycle hire availability near a point
look up stop or station details by ID or search

apis.name: The Graph
apis.tagline: Decentralized indexing protocol for querying blockchain data via GraphQL
apis.description: The Graph is a decentralized protocol for indexing and querying blockchain data. Developers deploy or query subgraphs—open GraphQL APIs over Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and many other networks—using hosted gateways or the decentralized network. Common use cases include on-chain balances, NFT metadata, DeFi protocol state, and historical event streams without running your own indexer.

auth.details: API key in the endpoint path, or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY with the key omitted from the path.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100,000 queries/month
pricing.paid_plans: Growth Plan usage pricing; currently advertised at $2 per additional 100,000 queries, payable by card or GRT.

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: query indexed Ethereum smart contract events via GraphQL
fetch NFT collection metadata and transfer history from a subgraph
get DeFi protocol TVL and pool state from published subgraphs
stream historical on-chain activity without running a full node
look up token balances and transfers across supported chains

apis.name: The Muse
apis.tagline: Job and company culture API for career discovery and employer branding.
apis.description: The Muse API provides access to job listings, company profiles, and workplace culture data for career discovery applications. It enables developers to search jobs by location, level, and category, and to retrieve employer branding content including company descriptions and office locations.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter; free self-serve registration on developer portal

pricing.free_tier_limits: 500 requests per hour without an API key; 3,600 requests per hour with a registered app's API key.

apis.rate_limits: 500 requests per hour without an API key; 3,600 requests per hour with an API key. Responses include X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers.
use_cases: search job listings by location and category
fetch company culture and employer branding profiles
list jobs for a specific company
filter open roles by experience level

apis.name: The Odds API
apis.tagline: Sports betting odds from many bookmakers with a free monthly developer quota
apis.description: The Odds API aggregates real-time and historical sports betting odds from dozens of bookmakers worldwide. It covers major sports and leagues with endpoints for events, odds, scores, and participant data. Developers authenticate with a self-serve API key and start on a free monthly request quota, with paid tiers for higher volume and historical data access.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter (self-serve signup); key also accepted in some client examples. No OAuth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 500 credits/month free (odds endpoints may cost multiple credits per region; GET /sports is free)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans scale by monthly request volume; see official pricing

apis.rate_limits: 30 requests/second on paid usage plans; 429 responses may still occur during bursts. Free-plan request-rate limit is not clearly published.
use_cases: list active sports and leagues available for odds
get current betting odds for a sport across bookmakers
fetch live scores for upcoming or in-play events
compare bookmaker odds for arbitrage or value spotting
pull historical odds snapshots for backtesting models

apis.name: The Things Network
apis.tagline: Global community LoRaWAN network for low-power IoT device uplink and downlink
apis.description: The Things Network (TTN) is a global community LoRaWAN network that connects low-power sensors and devices through shared gateways. Developers use application-layer integrations (HTTP webhooks, MQTT, Storage API) on The Things Stack to receive uplinks, send downlinks, and manage end devices. Community coverage is free; enterprise and cloud offerings come from The Things Industries.

auth.details: API key (Bearer token) from the Application Console; used as Authorization: Bearer NNSXS... for Storage API and as webhook secret or MQTT credentials depending on integration

pricing.free_tier_limits: Community network free for fair-use LoRaWAN traffic; Storage Integration limited retention; paid plans via The Things Industries Cloud/Enterprise — exact API request quotas not published as a simple free-tier number
pricing.paid_plans: The Things Industries Cloud and Enterprise for managed/private stacks

apis.rate_limits: not published as a single public API quota; Fair Use Policy applies to community network airtime and infrastructure
use_cases: receive LoRaWAN sensor uplink payloads via HTTP webhook
send downlink commands to end devices
query recent device uplinks from Storage Integration API
list and manage application end devices via Network Server API
subscribe to live device traffic over MQTT

apis.name: Trivia API (The Trivia API)
apis.tagline: Modern trivia questions API with tags, regions, and free public access
apis.description: Public trivia questions API with categories, difficulty filters, tags, and region options. Basic question endpoints work without a key; subscriptions unlock higher limits and commercial use via x-api-key.

auth.details: No key is required for basic public question requests; subscribed features use an API key in the x-api-key header.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC 4.0); higher limits with a free/subscription API key.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial/premium subscriptions available for commercial use and higher rate limits (see site pricing).

apis.rate_limits: Rate limits exist and are higher with an API key; exact numeric limits not clearly published on public docs
use_cases: fetch trivia questions for a quiz game
filter trivia by category and difficulty

apis.name: The Audio DB
apis.tagline: Music metadata API for artists, albums, tracks, and music videos
apis.description: The Audio DB (theaudiodb.com) is a community-oriented music metadata API providing structured data on artists, albums, tracks, music videos, and related media. Developers can look up discographies, biographies, artwork, and genre information for music catalog, media player, and discovery applications.

auth.details: API key as path segment in URL (e.g. /api/v1/json/{API_KEY}/search.php). Free test key 2 is commonly documented; paid/premium keys via signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Music API (€0): public free test key; restricted methods/result counts on many V1 endpoints vs premium. Free rate limit 30 req/min. Premium unlocks fuller V1 methods and V2 API access.
pricing.paid_plans: Single Developer €8/month (premium V1 methods, higher limits, MusicBrainz lookups, music videos). Small Business €20/month (120 req/min, social links, dedicated support, private key). Lifetime options also listed on pricing page.

apis.rate_limits: Free: 30 requests/minute; Premium: 100/minute; Business: 120/minute. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429; wait about one minute before retrying.
use_cases: look up artist biography and metadata by name
fetch album discography for an artist
get track listing for an album
retrieve music video links for an artist
search artists by genre or style for discovery UIs

apis.name: The Cat API
apis.tagline: Cat images, breeds, and favourites for demos and apps.
apis.description: Public API for cat images and breed data with favourites and a free tier.

auth.details: API key sent in the x-api-key request header; obtain a key through The Cat API signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 10,000 requests/month on free tier (see pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: Startup $99/month (100,000 requests/month); Enterprise custom pricing (contact for unlimited requests and bespoke features).

apis.rate_limits: Free: ~10,000 req/month; higher tiers on paid plans (see pricing)
use_cases: get random cat image
list cat breeds

apis.name: TheCocktailDB
apis.tagline: Free cocktail recipe API with drinks, ingredients, and images.
apis.description: TheCocktailDB is a public REST API for cocktail and drink recipes. It provides searchable data for drinks by name, ingredient, category, and glass type, plus full recipe details (ingredients, measures, instructions) and drink images. Developers use it for cocktail apps, recipe search, and menu builders. A free tier is available with an optional paid upgrade for higher limits and premium features.

auth.details: API key in URL path (e.g. /api/json/v1/{API_KEY}/). Free test key "1" works for development; paid keys via Patreon.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free test key "1" for development/educational use; production/public app-store use requires Premium (~$10/£10 one-off via PayPal). Free list capped at 100 items; Premium unlocks multi-ingredient filter, popular/latest, full DB listing, image APIs. (Current docs use PayPal Premium, not Patreon.)
pricing.paid_plans: Premium API key via one-time PayPal purchase (~$10 lifetime) for production/app-store use and premium features (multi-ingredient filter, popular/latest, full DB listing, image APIs). FAQ still mentions legacy Patreon support + email for a production key.

apis.rate_limits: Official FAQ: no limits / unlimited usage (no numeric req/min published).

example.response_snippet: {"drinks":[{"idDrink":"11007","strDrink":"Margarita","strCategory":"Ordinary Drink","strAlcoholic":"Alcoholic","strGlass":"Cocktail glass","strInstructions":"Rub the rim of the glass with the lime slice...","strIngredient1":"Tequila","strMeasure1":"1 1/2 oz "}]}

use_cases: search cocktails by name
look up recipe by drink ID
list drinks by ingredient
filter cocktails by category or glass
get random cocktail suggestion
fetch drink images for a recipe UI

apis.name: TheMealDB
apis.tagline: Free recipe and meal database API for meals, ingredients, and categories
apis.description: TheMealDB is a free open recipe database with a REST API for searching meals by name, ingredient, category, or area; looking up full recipes with instructions and images; listing categories and random meals. Popular with developers for demos and food apps. Free test key is available; premium paid keys unlock higher limits.

auth.details: API key in URL path as /api/json/v1/{API_KEY}/... Free test key is 1. Premium keys available via Patreon/subscription.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free test key "1" for development/education; free full-list capped at ~100 items. Premium (~$10 lifetime) unlocks V2 endpoints, full listing, and production key.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium API key via TheMealDB Patreon/subscription

apis.rate_limits: No published rate limits; FAQ states unlimited usage.

example.response_snippet: {"meals":[{"idMeal":"52771","strMeal":"Spicy Arrabiata Penne","strCategory":"Vegetarian","strArea":"Italian","strInstructions":"Bring a large pot of water to a boil...","strMealThumb":"https://www.themealdb.com/images/media/meals/...","strIngredient1":"penne rigate","strMeasure1":"1 pound"}]}

use_cases: search recipes by meal name
look up full recipe with ingredients and instructions
filter meals by main ingredient
list meal categories or random meal ideas
get meals by cuisine/area

apis.name: The News API
apis.tagline: Global news search and top headlines API with multi-language coverage
apis.description: The News API aggregates news articles from thousands of sources worldwide. It provides endpoints for top headlines, all-news search, and similar-article discovery with filters for language, country, category, and date range.

auth.details: API token via query parameter api_token (self-serve signup)

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/day; up to 3 articles per news request.
pricing.paid_plans: Basic $19/mo ($16/mo annual), Standard $49/mo ($41/mo annual), Pro $79/mo ($66/mo annual); custom plans available.

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: fetch top headlines for a country
search recent articles by keyword
filter news by language or category
find similar articles to a URL

apis.name: TheSportsDB
apis.tagline: Free multi-sport database API for teams, events, players, and league data with media assets
apis.description: TheSportsDB provides a free multi-sport REST API covering football, basketball, baseball, hockey, motorsport, and more. Developers can look up teams, leagues, fixtures/events, players, and standings, and often pull team badges and other media. It is commonly used in hobby apps, sports dashboards, and learning projects. Free access uses a shared demo key with limited data; paid plans unlock higher limits and fuller datasets. Authentication is via API key in the URL path.

auth.details: API key in the URL path as /api/v1/json/{API_KEY}/... Free demo key is 123. Paid keys from site membership.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 30 requests/minute, with endpoint-specific limits on returned records; public app-store releases require a paid subscription.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium membership tiers available via thesportsdb.com (check site for current pricing)

apis.rate_limits: Free: 30 requests/minute; Premium: 100/minute; Business: 120/minute; excess requests return HTTP 429.

example.response_snippet: {"teams":[{"idTeam":"133604","strTeam":"Arsenal","strTeamShort":"ARS","strAlternate":"Arsenal Football Club, AFC, Arsenal FC","strLeague":"English Premier League","strStadium":"Emirates Stadium","strBadge":"https://..."}]}

use_cases: search for a sports team by name and get badge/logo URL
look up upcoming or past events/fixtures for a team or league
fetch player details and career metadata by name
list leagues or teams in a sport for a sports directory app
get league table/standings for a competition

apis.name: TheTVDB API
apis.tagline: TV series, episode, and artwork metadata API for media libraries and scrapers
apis.description: TheTVDB provides a v4 REST API for TV series, seasons, episodes, movies, people, artwork, and related metadata. Developers create a project API key through their account dashboard, exchange it at POST /login for a one-month Bearer JWT, and send that token on later requests. Access is available through revenue-based project licensing or a separate subscriber-supported API-key/PIN model.

auth.details: Project API key via POST /login for a Bearer JWT; send Authorization: Bearer <token> on subsequent requests. Self-serve keys in Subscriber Portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free project licensing applies when annual company revenue is under $50,000 and requires attribution. The public pricing page lists no numeric request allowance.
pricing.paid_plans: Subscriber tiers (user/commercial) via TheTVDB Subscriber Portal; exact plan names/prices not confirmed from public docs alone

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: look up a TV series by name or TVDB id
list seasons and episodes for a series
fetch episode air dates and absolute numbers
get series artwork and posters for a media library
resolve people (actors/creators) linked to a show
search multilingual TV metadata for scrapers

apis.name: They Said So Quotes
apis.tagline: Famous quotes API with categories, authors, and a daily quote endpoint.
apis.description: They Said So provides a REST API for retrieving famous quotes by category, author, keyword, or as a quote of the day. Responses include quote text, author, tags, and metadata. Free and paid plans are offered; free access has strict daily request caps suitable for light demos and learning projects.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header (or X-TheySaidSo-Api-Secret for some clients); free tier may work without a key with tighter limits. Self-serve signup on theysaidso.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public endpoints: 10 calls/hour without authentication; higher limits require a paid plan.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium $9.99/mo (2,500 calls/day), Ultra $24.99/mo (8,000/day), Enterprise $74.99/mo (unlimited). Confirm on pricing page before publish.

apis.rate_limits: Free unauthenticated ~10 req/hour; higher on free key and paid plans (see pricing)
use_cases: get the quote of the day
fetch quotes by category or keyword
look up quotes by a specific author
populate an inspiration or education feature with curated quotes

apis.name: ThingsBoard
apis.tagline: Open-source IoT platform REST API for devices, telemetry, rules, and dashboards
apis.description: ThingsBoard Community Edition is an open-source IoT platform; Cloud and Professional editions are also offered. Its REST API manages platform entities, integrations, device provisioning, telemetry, attributes, alarms, rule chains, dashboards, and custom applications. API-key authentication via X-Authorization: ApiKey is recommended; username/password JWT login remains supported but is deprecated. Device transport APIs use separate device credentials.

auth.details: POST /api/auth/login with username/password returns JWT; send as X-Authorization: Bearer $JWT (or Authorization). Device APIs may use access tokens. Self-host and cloud.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Community Edition: free, open-source self-hosting with unlimited devices/assets. Cloud Free ($0/month): 5 devices, 5 assets, 2 customers, 5 users, 5 dashboards, 3 rule chains; 0.5M transport messages and 1M data points/month; 30-day TTL.
pricing.paid_plans: ThingsBoard Cloud and PE paid tiers; self-host PE licenses

apis.rate_limits: Cloud REST limits: Free—tenant 100 requests/s and 1,000/min; customer 50/s and 500/min. Paid plans—tenant 100/s and 2,000/min; customer 50/s and 1,000/min. Transport, device, gateway, and WebSocket limits are also published by plan.
use_cases: login and obtain JWT for ThingsBoard REST API
list tenant devices and their credentials
post or query device telemetry timeseries
read or write device/server-side attributes
create or acknowledge IoT alarms
manage dashboards and rule chains via REST

apis.name: This Person Does Not Exist
apis.tagline: AI-generated face images for novelty and placeholder avatars
apis.description: Service that generates photorealistic AI face images, often used as novelty or placeholder avatars. Related to UI Faces / fake-faces alternatives. Research focuses on whether a documented public API exists and how developers can integrate it.

auth.details: Research pending — verify if any public API authentication is required

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.response_snippet: JPEG image binary of an AI-generated face

use_cases: generate a random AI face for a placeholder avatar
fetch a novelty photorealistic face image for demos

apis.name: ThreatFox
apis.tagline: IOC-sharing API for malware C2, IPs, domains, and URLs
apis.description: ThreatFox is a community platform operated by abuse.ch in collaboration with Spamhaus for sharing and querying malware-related IOCs. Its Auth-Key API supports recent-IOC retrieval, lookup by IOC ID or value, searches by file hash, tag, or malware family, and submission of confirmed, vetted IOCs. Free use is limited to authenticated not-for-profit use under fair-use query limits; commercial use may require a paid Spamhaus subscription.

auth.details: API key via Auth-Key header (or optional api-key form field); free key from auth.abuse.ch after account signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for authenticated not-for-profit use, subject to unpublished fair-use query-volume limits. Excessive use may be restricted or require a paid Spamhaus subscription; high-value contributors may receive discretionary access beyond the limits.

apis.rate_limits: not fully published as numeric quotas; abuse.ch enforces rate limiting (HTTP 429); check docs/status for current guidance
use_cases: fetch recent malware C2 IOCs from the last N days
look up whether a domain, IP, or URL is a known threat IOC
search ThreatFox by malware family name
submit a new C2 or phishing IOC to the community feed
export IOCs in a format for SIEM or blocklist tooling

apis.name: Thunderforest
apis.tagline: Specialized OSM map tiles for outdoors, cycling, transport, and more
apis.description: Thunderforest provides raster map tile services built on OpenStreetMap data, with styles including Outdoors, Cycle, Transport, Landscape, Pioneer, Mobile Atlas, and Neighbourhood. Developers request PNG tiles over HTTPS via standard XYZ tile URLs with an API key, for use in web maps, mobile apps, and GIS tools. A free developer plan includes a monthly tile quota; higher commercial plans are available.

auth.details: API key as `apikey` query parameter on tile URLs (e.g. `?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY`). Obtain free via account signup on thunderforest.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 150,000 tiles/month free (Hobby project plan); attribution required
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from ~$14/month with higher tile quotas; commercial licensing available — see pricing page

apis.rate_limits: not published separately from monthly tile quotas

example.response_snippet:
HTTP 200 OK
Content-Type: image/png
(binary 256×256 PNG tile saved as tile.png)

use_cases: render outdoor hiking/trail basemap tiles in a web or mobile map
display cycling-oriented map tiles for bike route apps
show public transport map style for transit-focused UIs
add landscape or pioneer basemap tiles to a GIS viewer
swap OSM raster tile styles with an API key on standard XYZ URLs

apis.name: Tibber API
apis.tagline: Nordic/EU smart energy GraphQL API for live prices, consumption, and home devices
apis.description: Tibber provides authenticated GraphQL access to account and home metadata, electricity prices, historical consumption and production, and real-time Pulse/Watty measurements via subscriptions. The published schema does not document operations for controlling EV chargers or smart plugs; connected-device data is offered separately through Tibber's Data API.

auth.details: Personal Access Token (Bearer) from developer portal; send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY on GraphQL requests

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: No numeric HTTP request quota is published. Maximum 2 open WebSocket connections; clients must use jittered exponential backoff. Tibber recommends querying today/tomorrow prices only once daily and caching them.

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.tibber.com/v1-beta/gql -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "User-Agent: curl/8.7.1 MyTibberClient/1.0.0" -d '{"query":"{ viewer { name homes { id address { address1 city } } } }"}'

use_cases: get current electricity price for a home
fetch hourly price forecast for smart scheduling
read real-time power consumption for a home
list connected homes and devices for a user
control smart plugs or EV charger based on price
subscribe to live consumption or price updates via GraphQL

apis.name: Ticketmaster Discovery API
apis.tagline: Search live events, venues, and attractions across Ticketmaster inventory worldwide
apis.description: Ticketmaster's Discovery API provides read-only access to event, venue, attraction, and classification data from Ticketmaster's global inventory. Developers can search and filter concerts, sports, arts, and other live events by keyword, location, date, classification, and more, with paginated JSON responses suitable for event discovery apps and aggregators.

apis.name: Tiingo

get latest EOD price for one or more tickers
pull consolidated crypto prices across exchanges
stream or poll IEX real-time equity quotes
search financial news articles for a ticker or topic
retrieve U.S. fundamental indicators for equities

apis.name: Traccar

apis.name: UK Carbon Intensity API
apis.tagline: National Grid ESO free API for GB carbon intensity forecasts by region and generation mix.
apis.description: The National Energy System Operator (NESO) Carbon Intensity API provides current estimated and forecast carbon-intensity data for Great Britain, including national and regional data, generation mix, and intensity bands. Forecasts are updated every 30 minutes. Access is free and unauthenticated, but subject to an unspecified rate limit.

auth.details: No authentication required. The API is free and open to all developers without the need for an API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Currently free, but subject to the terms of use and an unspecified rate limit; NESO may block applications making a large number of calls.

apis.rate_limits: NESO applies a rate limit and may block applications making a large number of calls. No numerical threshold is published.
use_cases: get current carbon intensity for Great Britain
forecast carbon intensity for a specific region
retrieve generation mix data for electricity production
monitor carbon intensity levels over time
integrate carbon intensity data into smart home systems
analyze regional variations in carbon intensity

apis.name: legislation.gov.uk API
apis.tagline: UK primary and secondary legislation as structured XML and data
apis.description: Official API for UK legislation from legislation.gov.uk, providing access to primary and secondary legislation as structured data (including Akoma Ntoso/XML). Supports retrieval of acts, statutory instruments, and related legislative content for legal research and applications.

auth.details: No authentication required for public access.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 3,000 requests in any 5-minute period; non-browser clients must send a legitimate identifying User-Agent.

apis.rate_limits: 3,000 requests in any 5-minute period. Excess requests may be blocked; the service may temporarily reduce the limit.
use_cases: fetch full text of a UK Act by year and chapter
retrieve statutory instrument as structured XML
list legislation by type and year
get table of contents for an Act
access revised legislation versions

apis.name: UK Parliament API
apis.tagline: Open parliamentary data on Members, bills, votes, Hansard, and more
apis.description: A family of free open-data APIs from the UK Parliament for Members, interests, Commons votes, committees, bills, statutory instruments, and related parliamentary information. The official developer hub at developer.parliament.uk lists the supported public endpoints; many modern services use subdomain APIs (e.g. members-api, bills-api) with OpenAPI specs and no authentication for public read access.

auth.details: Public open-data endpoints require no API key or signup; call HTTPS endpoints directly. Confirm per-service docs if any restricted routes exist.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free open data; no paid plans published

apis.rate_limits: not published (rate limiting mentioned generically; no public numeric limits)
use_cases: look up a UK MP or peer by name
get a Member's constituency and party details
list Members of the House of Commons or Lords
search bills and track legislative stages
fetch Commons division (vote) results
query committee membership and business

apis.name: data.police.uk API
apis.tagline: UK street-level crime, outcomes, and neighbourhood policing data
apis.description: Public REST API from UK police forces providing street-level crime and outcome data, neighbourhood boundaries, and local policing team information. Free with no authentication required for standard use. Covers England, Wales, and Northern Ireland crime data.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints. API is free and open.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Unlimited free access; no key required

apis.rate_limits: 15 requests per second with a burst of 30; on average, fewer than 15 requests per second. Excess requests receive HTTP 429. Calls over time are unlimited.
use_cases: get street-level crimes near a lat/lng
list crime categories for a date
get neighbourhood boundaries for a force
find outcomes for a specific crime
locate nearest police neighbourhood for coordinates

apis.name: UMLS Terminology Services
apis.tagline: NIH UMLS REST API for medical concepts, CUIs, and crosswalks
apis.description: The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) Terminology Services REST API provides programmatic access to UMLS Metathesaurus data including concepts, CUIs, atoms, relations, and source vocabulary crosswalks. Developers authenticate with a UTS API key obtained after free UMLS license approval.

auth.details: API key obtained after free UMLS license approval; typically passed as ticket parameter or Authorization header depending on endpoint version

pricing.free_tier_limits: 20 requests per second per IP address; NLM recommends caching results for 12–24 hours.

apis.rate_limits: 20 requests per second per IP address. Excess requests may not be serviced until the request rate falls below the limit.
use_cases: look up a medical concept by CUI
search UMLS Metathesaurus for a term
crosswalk codes between source vocabularies
retrieve concept definitions and semantic types
get related concepts and hierarchical relations

apis.name: UN Comtrade API
apis.tagline: UN official API for global merchandise trade statistics by country, product, and partner
apis.description: The UN Comtrade API provides official global trade statistics by reporter, partner, commodity classification, period, and trade flow. Tightly limited preview APIs work without an account or key. Registered free users can obtain a subscription key for broader Data API access, while premium subscriptions add bulk and asynchronous APIs, larger per-call limits, and higher daily quotas.

auth.details: Primary key (subscription key) via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header after free self-serve registration at comtradedeveloper.un.org; also accepted as subscription-key query parameter

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Basic Individual: up to 500 API calls/day and 100,000 Data API records per call.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium/enterprise products via UN Comtrade developer portal; contact UN for bulk/commercial licensing

apis.rate_limits: Free: ~500 requests/day; premium tiers higher — confirm exact product quotas on comtradedeveloper.un.org
use_cases: get annual HS trade totals for a reporter country and partner
list merchandise import/export values by commodity code and year
pull multi-year trade series for economic research or dashboards
compare bilateral trade flows between two countries
export Comtrade query results as CSV for offline analysis

apis.name: UNdata
apis.tagline: Official SDMX REST/SOAP API for United Nations statistical databases
apis.description: UNdata’s public API (powered by Eurostat SDMX-RI) gives programmatic access to UN statistical datamarts via SDMX REST and SOAP. List dataflows, pull data structure definitions and codelists, and query multi-dimensional series (XML, JSON, or CSV). Free under UNdata Terms of Use; no signup or API key. Not all UNdata datamarts are exposed until DSDs are mapped.

auth.details: No authentication, API key, or signup. Structure and data endpoints respond to unauthenticated HTTPS GET/POST (REST and SOAP).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free of charge under UNdata Terms of Use; no published numeric free-tier request caps

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.response_snippet:
