use_cases: list available UNdata SDMX dataflows/datamarts
query air-emission or other UN statistical series by period
fetch data structure definitions and codelists for a dataflow
download multi-dimensional UN indicators as XML, JSON, or CSV
filter series by dimension codes and start/end period

apis.name: UniProt
apis.tagline: Universal protein sequence and functional annotation REST API
apis.description: UniProt provides free REST access to the Universal Protein Resource: protein sequences, function annotations, taxonomy, and cross-references across Swiss-Prot and TrEMBL. Developers query by accession, search with Lucene-style syntax, stream bulk downloads, and retrieve JSON or other formats from rest.uniprot.org without API keys for typical use.

auth.details: No API key or account required for public REST access; requests are open over HTTPS. Heavy bulk use should follow published rate guidance and contact UniProt support if needed.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public academic resource; no paid plans. Practical limits are rate-based (see rate_limits), not a free-tier quota.

apis.rate_limits: No fixed public hard per-IP rate (e.g. ~5 req/s) is currently documented on UniProt API help. Fair-use guidance applies; prefer streaming and bulk downloads for large jobs. Contact UniProt support for sustained high volume.
use_cases: fetch protein sequence and annotations by UniProt accession
search UniProtKB with gene name or organism filters
retrieve cross-references to PDB, Ensembl, or GO for a protein
stream bulk UniProt entries for offline analysis
map protein IDs across databases via UniProt ID mapping
get taxonomy-linked protein sets for a species

apis.name: Universe API
apis.tagline: Ticketmaster-owned event creation and ticketing API for independent organizers
apis.description: Universe's API lets organizers retrieve event details, attendee or guest-list data, and sales data. Documented write operations include creating discount codes and access keys and checking in tickets; current documentation does not substantiate API-based event creation or general ticket-inventory updates.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 access tokens; application registration required via developer portal

pricing.free_tier_limits: GraphQL API access is included with Starter. Accounts, event pages, and free events have no upfront or service fees; paid tickets incur service and payment-processing fees. No API-call quota is published.

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list events for an organizer
create a new ticketed event
fetch attendee lists for an event
update ticket inventory

apis.name: Untappd
apis.tagline: Social beer check-in API for breweries, bars, and craft-beer discovery apps
apis.description: Untappd provides a REST API for beer search, brewery and venue data, user check-ins, and related social beer-tracking features. Developers authenticate with OAuth 2.0 (client credentials / user auth) and call versioned endpoints under the public API host. Official documentation, pricing, and rate-limit details should be verified on Untappd’s developer site before production use.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0: register an app for client_id/client_secret; user flows use access tokens; some endpoints accept client_id as query param for read-only public data.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No public free self-serve tier; API access requires app registration and approval/commercial terms (new keys restricted)

apis.rate_limits: 100 calls per hour per key; with user auth, limit applies per user. Headers: X-Ratelimit-Limit, X-Ratelimit-Remaining
use_cases: search beers by name or style
get brewery details and beer list
look up a venue's beer menu or check-ins
fetch a user's recent check-ins
get beer ratings and stats by beer ID

apis.name: URLHaus
apis.tagline: Malware URL threat intelligence sharing API from abuse.ch
apis.description: URLhaus is a malware-URL intelligence platform operated by abuse.ch and Spamhaus. Its APIs support querying and downloading intelligence and submitting URLs directly used to distribute malware. Phishing sites and phishing-kit hosts are explicitly outside its submission scope.

auth.details: Auth-Key header required (abuse.ch Auth Key from auth.abuse.ch); free self-serve registration

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for authenticated not-for-profit use under fair-use and query-volume limits. High-value contributors may receive discretionary free access beyond those limits. Commercial or for-profit use may require a paid Spamhaus subscription.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial licensing available via abuse.ch

apis.rate_limits: No API-wide requests-per-minute quota is published. Database dumps should not be fetched more than once every 5 minutes; recent-URL and recent-payload queries return at most 1,000 entries.
use_cases: check if a URL is known malware or phishing
download recent malicious URL blocklists
look up payload hashes linked to a malware URL
submit a newly discovered malware URL
get host-based malware URL history

apis.name: urlscan.io
apis.tagline: Live website scanning and sandboxing for phishing and malware investigation.
apis.description: urlscan.io is a public API for submitting URLs to a browser sandbox, capturing screenshots, network activity, DOM, and threat indicators. Used by security teams and researchers to investigate phishing, malware, and suspicious sites with search and result APIs.

auth.details: API key via API-Key header (or ?apiKey= query param on some endpoints); self-serve signup at urlscan.io. Public search may work unauthenticated with lower limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan daily quotas (via UI or API): 50 private scans, 1,000 unlisted scans, 5,000 public scans, 1,000 search requests, 1,000 result requests; per-minute/hour caps also apply (see /user/quotas/).
pricing.paid_plans: API Only Automate from $5,000/yr; Professional $1,250/mo ($12,500/yr); Enterprise $2,500/mo ($25,000/yr); Ultimate $5,000/mo ($50,000/yr). 30-day commercial trials available.

apis.rate_limits: Per-action quotas with separate minute, hour, and day windows; HTTP 429 when exceeded; exact limits via GET https://urlscan.io/user/quotas/ (or /api/v1/quotas) and X-Rate-Limit-* response headers. Fixed-window resets at full minute/hour and midnight UTC; only HTTP 200 counts.
use_cases: submit a URL for sandbox scanning and get a result UUID
fetch scan result JSON including network requests and screenshots
search historical urlscan results for a domain or hash
check if a URL has been scanned before for phishing investigation

apis.name: Treasury.gov Fiscal Data
apis.tagline: Free open REST API for U.S. Treasury debt, rates, statements, and fiscal datasets
apis.description: Official Bureau of the Fiscal Service API serving standardized U.S. federal fiscal datasets—public debt (Debt to the Penny), average interest rates, Daily/Monthly Treasury Statements, exchange rates, savings bonds, auctions, and related tables. Open RESTful GET API returning JSON (default), XML, or CSV with field selection, filters, sorting, and pagination. No registration or API key required; data is free for commercial and non-commercial use.

auth.details: Open public API: no user account, registration, token, or API key required. Documented as accessible via plain GET in a browser or script. Response table lists 403 'API Key is not valid' but docs do not describe obtaining or sending a key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free open data; no registration, usage quotas, or paid plans published

apis.rate_limits: not published (default page size 100; pagination via page[number] and page[size]; no published req/min or req/day limits)
use_cases: get current total U.S. public debt outstanding (Debt to the Penny)
fetch historical average interest rates on Treasury securities
pull Daily Treasury Statement operating cash balance by date
query Treasury reporting exchange rates for a currency and date range
download Monthly Treasury Statement federal receipts or outlays series
list recent Treasury securities auction results and yields

apis.name: USAJOBS
apis.tagline: Official U.S. federal government job listings API for searching public sector openings.
apis.description: USAJOBS provides a free REST API for searching and retrieving U.S. federal job opportunity announcements. Developers register for an API key and call data.usajobs.gov endpoints with Host, User-Agent, and Authorization-Key headers. Responses are JSON and cover job titles, locations, agencies, pay, and application details for building job boards, alerts, and career tools.

auth.details: API key via Authorization-Key header plus User-Agent (email) and Host headers; self-serve registration on developer.usajobs.gov.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Official pricing/free-tier terms are not published. API-token registration is required. Published access limits: Search Jobs—10,000 rows per query and 500 per page; Code List and Dynamic Search—no limits.

apis.rate_limits: Search Jobs: maximum 10,000 rows per query and 500 rows per page. Code List API and Dynamic Search: no limits. No requests-per-second or requests-per-day quota is published.
use_cases: search federal job openings by keyword and location
list recent vacancies for a specific agency or series
fetch job opportunity announcement details for a position
build alerts when new federal roles match a skill set
aggregate public-sector openings for a career board

apis.name: USA Spending API
apis.tagline: Federal award spending data from USAspending.gov for contracts, grants, loans, and more.
apis.description: Public REST API from the U.S. Treasury’s USAspending.gov that exposes federal award and spending data: contracts, grants, loans, direct payments, and agency budgets. Developers query awards, recipients, agencies, and geographic breakdowns as JSON without an API key for most endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints; requests are open over HTTPS.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public API; no paid plans or usage quotas published

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: search federal contract awards by agency or keyword
look up grant spending for a recipient or location
list top-tier federal agencies and budget authority
get award details for a known award ID
break down federal spending by state or congressional district

apis.name: USDA ERS Data API
apis.tagline: USDA Agricultural Resource Management Survey (ARMS) farm finance data via REST and GraphQL
apis.description: USDA Economic Research Service (ERS) Data APIs provide programmatic access to Agricultural Resource Management Survey (ARMS) farm financial and structural data—income statements, balance sheets, government payments, operator household finances, and related variables—by year, state, farm type, and category. Delivered as JSON over REST (and GraphQL) behind api.data.gov API keys. Free self-serve registration; HTTPS required.

auth.details: Free API key via api.data.gov self-serve signup (name + email). Pass as api_key query parameter (as in ERS docs) or X-Api-Key header (api.data.gov standard). DEMO_KEY works for light exploration.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free api.data.gov key; platform default 1,000 requests/hour for registered keys (limits may vary by service). DEMO_KEY much lower.

apis.rate_limits: Default: 1,000 requests/hour per API key across api.data.gov. DEMO_KEY: 30 requests/IP/hour and 50 requests/IP/day. Limits may vary by service; USDA ERS publishes no separate numeric limit.
use_cases: list available ARMS survey years for farm finance data
get farm income statement estimates by year and farm typology
retrieve gross cash farm income by operator age or region
list ARMS report types and variables for balance sheets and debt
query government payment statistics for commercial vs intermediate farms

apis.name: USDA FoodData Central
apis.tagline: Official US government food composition and nutrient data API
apis.description: USDA FoodData Central provides comprehensive food composition data including nutrients, portions, and branded products. Free API with key-based access for developers building nutrition apps, food databases, and dietary analysis tools.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter or X-Api-Key header; free self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: DEMO_KEY: 1,000 requests/hour per IP; personal free API keys: rate limits not clearly stated in official docs

apis.rate_limits: DEMO_KEY: 1,000 requests/hour per IP; personal free API keys: not clearly documented as 1,000/hour
use_cases: search foods by name and get nutrient profiles
look up detailed nutrition facts by FDC ID
compare nutrients across branded products
build meal planners with official USDA nutrient data
validate food composition for dietary apps

apis.name: USDA NASS Quick Stats
apis.tagline: Authoritative US crop, livestock, and farm economics survey and census data.
apis.description: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) Quick Stats API provides programmatic access to official U.S. agricultural statistics from surveys and the Census of Agriculture. Query crops, livestock, prices, inventory, acreage, production, and farm economics by commodity, geography, year, and statistic with a free API key.

auth.details: API key via query parameter `key`; free self-serve signup on the Quick Stats API page.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free with an API key; limited to 100 calls within five minutes and 50,000 records per response. No daily-call quota is published.

apis.rate_limits: 100 calls within five minutes.
use_cases: get corn production by state and year
pull livestock inventory for a county
compare crop prices across years
fetch Census of Agriculture farm counts by geography
export commodity statistics for a custom query

apis.name: Useless Facts
apis.tagline: Random useless facts API with English and German support, daily fact endpoint, and no authentication required.
apis.description: Public API that serves random and daily useless facts in English and German. Developers call simple GET endpoints on uselessfacts.jsph.pl with optional language and path variants; no API key or signup is needed. Responses are JSON (or plain text) and suit demos, chat bots, onboarding copy, and novelty features. Confirm live base URL, paths, CORS, and any published limits against official docs before production use.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoints; no API key, OAuth, or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: fetch a random English useless fact for a chat bot reply
get the daily useless fact for a homepage or newsletter widget
request a German-language random fact for localization demos
pull a fact as plain text for CLI or terminal tools
seed onboarding or empty-state copy with light novelty content

apis.name: USGS Earthquake Catalog API
apis.tagline: Real-time and historical global earthquake data from the USGS Earthquake Catalog
apis.description: USGS provides free, no-key public web services for real-time and historical earthquake data worldwide. The primary FDSN Event Web Service returns GeoJSON (and other formats) for queries by time, magnitude, location, and depth, plus real-time GeoJSON summary feeds for significant events. Data powers maps, alerts, research, and monitoring apps. No authentication is required for standard catalog and feed endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required for public FDSN Event and GeoJSON summary feed endpoints; free open government data.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public API; no paid plans. Usage expected to be reasonable; heavy automated use may be throttled.

apis.rate_limits: Not published as a fixed quota; USGS asks for reasonable use and may throttle abusive traffic. Prefer GeoJSON summary feeds for real-time maps over high-frequency catalog queries.

fetch historical quakes in a bounding box for a date range
get real-time GeoJSON feed of significant earthquakes for a map
look up details for a specific earthquake event ID
count earthquakes matching magnitude and time filters

apis.name: USGS Water Services
apis.tagline: Real-time and historical streamflow, groundwater, and water quality data from the U.S. Geological Survey.
apis.description: USGS Water Services provides free public REST APIs for real-time and historical hydrologic data, including streamflow, groundwater levels, water quality, and site metadata. Core services include Instantaneous Values (IV), Daily Values (DV), Site Service, and Groundwater Levels, with JSON, WaterML, and RDB formats. No API key is required for standard public access; rate limits apply for fair use. Data covers thousands of monitoring stations across the United States.

auth.details: No authentication required for public access. Requests are unauthenticated HTTPS GETs; no API key, OAuth, or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public service; no paid plans. Fair-use rate limits apply (see rate_limits).

apis.rate_limits: For small requests (e.g. up to 7–14 days for a single site): max 5–10 requests/sec steady; brief bursts of 40–50 requests/sec OK but not sustained. Excessive use may be blocked (HTTP 403).

use_cases: get real-time streamflow and gage height for a USGS site
fetch daily mean discharge for a date range
look up monitoring site metadata by state or bounding box
retrieve groundwater level time series for a well
pull multi-parameter instantaneous values as JSON for dashboards

apis.name: USPTO PatentsView
apis.tagline: Official USPTO patent search and bulk analytics API for US patents and inventors
apis.description: PatentsView enhances USPTO patent-grant and pre-grant-publication data into research-ready datasets. Its datasets and dictionaries are currently distributed through the USPTO Open Data Portal; PatentSearch API, search, visualization, and support functions have been paused since March 20, 2026 pending reintroduction in updated forms.

auth.details: API key required via X-Api-Key header; self-serve key request on PatentsView site

pricing.free_tier_limits: Not applicable while the PatentsView PatentSearch API is paused; current access is limited to datasets distributed through the USPTO Open Data Portal.

apis.rate_limits: No current limit because the API is paused. The legacy PatentSearch API limit was 45 requests per minute per API key.
use_cases: search US patents by keyword or patent number
look up inventors and assignees for a patent
retrieve citation networks for prior-art analysis
bulk-export patent metadata for analytics

apis.name: USPTO Trademark APIs
apis.tagline: Official USPTO APIs for trademark status, assignments, and bulk trademark data.
apis.description: Public USPTO developer APIs covering Trademark Status and Document Retrieval (TSDR), trademark assignment records, and bulk trademark data products for monitoring registration status, ownership changes, and large-scale trademark research.

auth.details: API key via request header after self-serve signup on developer.uspto.gov (confirm exact header name from current docs).

pricing.free_tier_limits: 60 requests/API key/minute; PDF/ZIP and multi-case PDF/ZIP: 4/key/minute. From 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. ET: 120 and 12/key/minute, respectively.

apis.rate_limits: 60 requests/API key/minute; PDF/ZIP and multi-case PDF/ZIP: 4/key/minute. Off-peak (10 p.m.–5 a.m. ET): 120 and 12/key/minute, respectively. Limits may change with system availability and usage.
use_cases: check trademark registration status by serial number
retrieve trademark assignment ownership history
download bulk trademark data for analysis
monitor trademark application progress

apis.name: Valhalla
apis.tagline: Open-source multimodal routing engine (route, matrix, isochrone, elevation)
apis.description: Valhalla is an open-source routing engine built on OpenStreetMap data. Public instances and self-hosted deployments expose REST endpoints for routes, time-distance matrices, isochrones, map matching, and elevation. Common uses include turn-by-turn navigation, catchment analysis, and logistics ETA/distance calculations.

auth.details: Public OSM.de instance requires no API key; self-hosted and commercial hosts may add their own auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public demo instance is free with fair-use rate limits; no paid product from the open-source project itself

apis.rate_limits: Maximum one request per second for valhalla1.openstreetmap.de.
use_cases: compute driving or walking routes between two points
build a travel-time matrix for multiple origins and destinations
generate isochrone polygons for reachability analysis
map-match GPS traces to the road network
sample elevation along a path or at coordinates

apis.name: Valorant-API
apis.tagline: Community REST API for Valorant agents, weapons, maps, and content without a Riot key.
apis.description: Valorant-API is a community-maintained public API that serves static Valorant game content—agents, weapons, maps, skins, bundles, and related assets—so developers can build tools and apps without a Riot Games API key. Responses are JSON over HTTPS, typically unauthenticated, and are aimed at catalogs, overlays, and content browsers rather than live match or account data.

auth.details: No authentication required for public static content endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: list all Valorant agents with roles and abilities
get weapon skins and levels for a catalog
fetch map metadata and splash images
look up content bundles and store offers metadata

apis.name: VATLayer API
apis.tagline: Real-time EU VAT rates and number validation for e-commerce checkout and tax compliance.
apis.description: VATLayer provides a REST API for European VAT compliance: live VAT rates by country, VAT number validation against official registries, price calculation with VAT, and related tax helpers. It is commonly used by e-commerce platforms and billing systems to apply correct VAT at checkout and verify business VAT IDs. Access is via an access_key query parameter after free or paid signup on vatlayer.com.

auth.details: API access_key as a query parameter (access_key=YOUR_API_KEY). Self-serve signup at vatlayer.com; free and paid plans available.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month free (Free plan); higher tiers available
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from Basic (~$9.99/mo) upward with higher monthly request quotas; see pricing page for current tiers

apis.rate_limits: Plan-based monthly request quotas; exact per-second rate limits not prominently published

auth.details: No API key, account, or other authentication is required for the Indicators API.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: retrieve GDP trends for a country
compare population growth across countries
fetch poverty rates by year
track school enrollment indicators
analyze life expectancy over time
list countries and regions

apis.name: World News API
apis.tagline: Global news search and extraction API with geo and sentiment filters.
apis.description: World News API provides search and retrieval of news articles from sources worldwide, with filters for location, language, sentiment, and entities. It offers search, top headlines, and extract endpoints for building news apps, media monitoring, and research tools.

auth.details: API key via api-key query parameter or header (self-serve signup).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free: 50 points/day (then no more calls until midnight UTC reset); 1-month history; backlink required. Points ≠ 1:1 requests (typical call costs ~1 point + 0.01/result).
pricing.paid_plans: Starter, Reporter, Journalist, Editor (paid tiers; daily point quotas + rate limits on official pricing).

apis.rate_limits: Published by plan. Free: 60 req/min, 1 concurrent; Reporter: 2 req/s, 5 concurrent; Journalist: 10 req/s, 10 concurrent; Editor: 20 req/s, 10 concurrent. Daily point quotas on pricing.
use_cases: search recent news by keyword
get top headlines by country
extract full text from a news URL

apis.name: World Weather Online
apis.tagline: Multi-product weather, marine, ski, and historical weather API with free trial
apis.description: World Weather Online provides weather, marine, ski, and historical weather data APIs for developers. It offers current conditions, forecasts, historical weather, and specialized products through a REST API with free trial access.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY, self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Permanent free plan (personal/educational/research, noncommercial, attribution required): 100 requests/day per pricing page; 14-day paid trials also offered (other first-party pages historically showed 500/day — reconcile in account dashboard)

apis.rate_limits: Free: 100 requests/day (pricing page); paid plans publish plan-specific daily caps; trial quotas may differ by product — confirm in developer dashboard
use_cases: get current weather for a city
get multi-day weather forecast
retrieve historical weather for a location
get marine weather conditions
get ski resort weather data

apis.name: Worldpay API
apis.tagline: Enterprise card payments and access APIs from a long-standing global acquirer.
apis.description: Access Worldpay offers RESTful HTTPS APIs for card payments, tokenization, 3DS, payouts, and related commerce flows. Its enterprise Card Payments APIs use HTTP Basic authentication with credentials supplied by a Worldpay Implementation Manager. Merchants test on try.access.worldpay.com and use access.worldpay.com for live traffic.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Authentication with username/password (or merchant credentials) issued via Worldpay; typically Authorization: Basic base64(username:password). Test credentials available on try.access.worldpay.com; production uses access.worldpay.com. Exact self-serve vs sales-led signup varies by product.

pricing.free_tier_limits: no free tier
pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise merchant pricing; contact Worldpay sales (not published as self-serve API pricing)

apis.rate_limits: Try environment: 10 requests per second per merchant. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429; Worldpay says to wait up to five minutes and remain below the limit. No Live-environment limit is stated.
use_cases: authorize a card payment
capture a previously authorized payment
refund a settled transaction
tokenize a card for recurring charges
run 3-D Secure authentication for a payment

apis.name: WorldTimeAPI
apis.tagline: Free public timezone and current time API by IANA zone or IP
apis.description: WorldTimeAPI is a free public REST service that returns the current local time, UTC offset, DST status, and related timezone metadata for any IANA timezone, for a client IP address, or for a given IP. Responses are JSON (or plain text). No API key is required. The project is community-maintained; capacity and uptime can vary, and heavy automated use is discouraged.

auth.details: No authentication. Public HTTP GET endpoints; no API key or signup required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Entirely free; no published free-tier quota or paid plans

apis.rate_limits: not published (community reports of intermittent rate limiting / capacity issues; heavy automated use discouraged)
use_cases: get current local time for an IANA timezone
list all available IANA timezone identifiers
resolve client or arbitrary IP address to local time and timezone
check DST status and UTC offset for a region
convert between unixtime and timezone-local datetime metadata

apis.name: X API
apis.tagline: Official X (Twitter) platform API for posts, users, search, and engagement.
apis.description: X API (formerly Twitter API) provides programmatic access to posts, user profiles, timelines, search, direct messages, media, and engagement data on X. Developers authenticate with OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens, call REST endpoints under api.x.com, and choose Free, Basic, Pro, or Enterprise tiers depending on volume and features.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 (user context) or OAuth 2.0 App-Only Bearer Token; also OAuth 1.0a. Create a Project/App in the X Developer Portal; use Authorization: Bearer YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN or OAuth signed requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier exists with very low write/read caps (e.g. limited posts/month and read requests); exact published numbers change — verify on developer.x.com pricing. Pay-as-you-go Basic/Pro for higher volume.
pricing.paid_plans: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers via developer.x.com; pricing and included request quotas vary by product (posts, search, etc.).

apis.rate_limits: Per-endpoint and per-app/user limits vary by product tier; published in X API rate-limit docs (e.g. many v2 read endpoints ~15–900 req/15 min depending on endpoint and auth).
use_cases: fetch a user profile by username
post a tweet/status on behalf of a user
search recent public posts by keyword
get a user’s recent timeline posts
lookup engagement metrics for a post
stream or poll mentions of a brand account

apis.name: xAI Grok API
apis.tagline: xAI Grok models for chat, tools, and image generation via a REST API
apis.description: xAI Grok API exposes Grok language and multimodal models for chat completions, tool calling, structured outputs, and image generation. Developers authenticate with API keys and call HTTPS endpoints under api.x.ai. The API is OpenAI-compatible for many chat paths, with xAI-specific models and features documented on docs.x.ai.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header. Create keys in the xAI Console (console.x.ai). Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown
pricing.paid_plans: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: chat with Grok models for reasoning and coding help
call tools / function calling from an agent
generate images with Grok image models
run OpenAI-compatible chat completions against Grok
stream long model responses for interactive apps

apis.name: Xero Accounting API
apis.tagline: Full accounting API for invoices, contacts, payments, and bank reconciliation.
apis.description: Xero Accounting API provides OAuth 2.0 access to invoices, contacts, payments, bank transactions, accounts, and reports across connected organisations. It supports accounting integrations and bookkeeping automation but does not expose unreconciled bank-statement data or permit bank-statement-line reconciliation through the public Accounting API.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 (authorization code) with tenant connection; Bearer access token plus Xero-Tenant-Id header on Accounting API calls. Apps registered in the Xero Developer portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Starter: no charge, maximum 5 connections, unlimited data access, and 1,000 API calls per day per connected organisation.

apis.rate_limits: Per tenant: 5 concurrent calls, 60 calls/minute, and 1,000 calls/day on Starter or 5,000 calls/day on higher tiers; plus 10,000 calls/minute app-wide across all tenants.

example.request: curl -X GET "https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Organisation" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H "Xero-Tenant-Id: YOUR_TENANT_ID" -H "Accept: application/json"

use_cases: list invoices for a Xero organisation
create a sales invoice for a contact
record a payment against an invoice
sync contacts and customers from Xero
fetch bank transactions for reconciliation
get organisation and chart of accounts details

apis.name: Yahoo Finance (unofficial)
apis.tagline: Unofficial market data endpoints used by Yahoo Finance clients
apis.description: Community-documented, unofficial Yahoo Finance query endpoints for quotes, charts, fundamentals, and related market data. Not an officially supported public product; endpoints, auth cookies, and rate limits can change without notice.

auth.details: No official API key. Many endpoints work unauthenticated; some scrapers use session cookies from finance.yahoo.com. Subject to change.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: get current stock quote for a ticker
fetch historical OHLCV chart data
look up company fundamentals
search tickers by company name

apis.name: Yelp Fusion
apis.tagline: Search local businesses, reviews, and photos via Yelp's public Fusion API.
apis.description: Yelp Fusion is Yelp's developer platform API for searching businesses, reading reviews and photos, and looking up places by phone or transaction type. It is commonly used for local discovery, restaurant search, and location-aware apps. Developers authenticate with a Bearer API key after creating an app in the Yelp Developer Portal.

auth.details: Bearer API key via Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY). Create an app in the Yelp Developer Portal to obtain a free API key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier available; exact request quotas and paid plan details vary by endpoint and should be confirmed on the current pricing page.

apis.rate_limits: Published per-endpoint daily quotas on the developer pricing page; not fully verified in this research pass.
use_cases: search restaurants and local businesses near a location
look up a business by Yelp ID for details and hours
find businesses by phone number
list reviews for a business
search businesses that support delivery or pickup

apis.name: Yes No API
apis.tagline: Simple yes/no/maybe answers with animated GIFs
apis.description: Free public API that returns a random yes, no, or maybe answer along with a matching animated GIF. No authentication required. Useful for playful decision UIs, demos, and novelty integrations.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public unauthenticated HTTP GET.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: get a random yes/no/maybe answer with a GIF
force a yes answer for demos
force a no answer for demos
power playful decision UIs
fetch novelty GIF responses for chatbots

apis.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! API (YGOPRODeck)
apis.tagline: Free Yu-Gi-Oh card database with images, sets, archetypes, and banlist data
apis.description: YGOPRODeck provides a free public REST API for Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG/OCG card data: names, effects, attributes, types, ATK/DEF, set codes, rarity, banlist status, archetypes, and card images. Commonly used for deck builders, price trackers, and card search tools without requiring authentication for basic card queries.

auth.details: No API key required for public card database endpoints; requests are made directly to the open REST API.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; rate limits apply (see rate_limits). No paid plans published for the core card database API.

apis.rate_limits: Published guidance historically around 20 requests/second; confirm current limits on official docs. Excess may return HTTP 429.

example.response_snippet: {"data":[{"id":46986414,"name":"Dark Magician","type":"Normal Monster","frameType":"normal","desc":"The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.","atk":2500,"def":2100,"level":7,"race":"Spellcaster","attribute":"DARK",...}]}

use_cases: look up a Yu-Gi-Oh card by name or ID
fetch card images for a deck list
get banlist status for a card
list cards in a set or archetype
search cards by type, attribute, or ATK/DEF filters

apis.name: Yo Momma Jokes
apis.tagline: Lightweight random yo-momma joke API for bots and novelty demos
apis.description: A free, no-auth public API that returns a single random yo-momma joke as JSON. Popular for chatbots, Discord/Slack bots, demos, and fun side projects. Simple GET endpoint with no signup required; response is a short joke string. Ideal when you need instant novelty humor without keys or SDKs.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoint; no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public API; no published quota (usage may be rate-limited at infrastructure level)

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.response_snippet: {"joke":"Yo momma so fat, when she sat on an iPhone, it turned into an iPad!"}

use_cases: get a random yo-momma joke for a chatbot reply
power a Discord or Slack novelty slash command
demo a simple public JSON API in a tutorial
add random humor to a CLI or terminal greeting
seed joke content for a fun web widget

apis.name: You.com Search API
apis.tagline: AI-native web search API for real-time results and citations
apis.description: You.com Search API provides AI-powered web search for developers and agents. It returns ranked results, snippets, and source citations suitable for grounding LLM answers, research workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation. Typical use is server-side with an API key; confirm current endpoints, auth headers, free-tier quotas, and rate limits in the official docs and pricing pages before production use.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header (self-serve signup on You.com platform); exact header name and key issuance flow confirmed in official docs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 queries/day on free search profile (per published docs); confirm current quotas on pricing/docs before production.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go / published Web Search pricing per 1,000 calls plus complimentary credits on pricing page — verify current $ amounts on official pricing.

apis.rate_limits: Free search profile: 100 queries/day; paid/auth tiers subscription-dependent; limits also exposed via X-RateLimit response headers.
use_cases: run web search for a coding agent answer with citations
ground an LLM response with current sources
fetch recent news and page snippets for a topic
power retrieval for RAG over the live web
compare multi-source answers for research tasks

apis.name: ZenQuotes
apis.tagline: Simple inspirational quotes API for apps and widgets
apis.description: ZenQuotes is a free public API that serves inspirational and motivational quotes in JSON format. It is designed for developers building apps, widgets, websites, and other projects that need random or daily quotes with minimal setup. The service provides endpoints for random quotes, daily quotes, and quote lists, and is commonly used without authentication for basic access.

auth.details: No authentication required for basic free endpoints; optional API key available for higher usage via self-serve signup on zenquotes.io.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 5 requests per 30 seconds per IP by default; API key or registered IP required for unlimited access
pricing.paid_plans: Premium subscriptions available via my.zenquotes.io: API key, unlimited requests, CORS headers, advanced calls, custom quotes (up to 500), and self-hosted option

apis.rate_limits: 5 requests per 30 seconds per IP by default; API key or registered IP required for unlimited access

example.response_snippet:
[{"q":"The only way to do great work is to love what you do.","a":"Steve Jobs","h":"
“The only way to do great work is to love what you do.” —
Steve Jobs
"}]

use_cases: fetch a random inspirational quote for a daily widget
get today's quote of the day for a homepage banner
pull a batch of quotes for offline caching in a mobile app
display motivational quotes in a Slack or Discord bot
seed demo content with famous author quotes

apis.name: ZenRows
apis.tagline: Anti-bot web scraping API with JavaScript rendering and proxy rotation
apis.description: ZenRows is a web scraping API that handles anti-bot protections, CAPTCHAs, JavaScript rendering, and rotating residential proxies so developers can extract HTML or structured data from hard-to-scrape sites without managing their own proxy infrastructure.

auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter (self-serve signup). Also supported as header in some SDKs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1,000 free API credits on signup (no ongoing free plan; trial-style allotment)

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: scrape HTML from anti-bot protected sites
render JavaScript-heavy pages before extraction
bypass CAPTCHAs and geo-blocked content
extract structured data via CSS selectors

apis.name: Zerion
apis.tagline: Wallet portfolio, DeFi positions, and transaction history API across many chains.
apis.description: Zerion API provides multi-chain wallet portfolio data, DeFi positions, transaction history, and related crypto data for developers building wallet and DeFi applications.

auth.details: API key authentication required; details to be verified from official docs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Developer plan: 2,000 requests per day and 3 requests per second. DeFi Positions, Wallet Portfolio Chart, and Wallet P&L endpoints are capped at 25% of the plan quota and are not covered by overages.

apis.rate_limits: Plan-based: Developer 3 RPS, Builder 10 RPS, Startup 25 RPS, and Enterprise 1,000+ RPS. Their quotas are 2,000/day, 250,000/month, 1,000,000/month, and 2,500,000+/month, respectively. Responses include limit, remaining-quota, and reset headers.
use_cases: get wallet portfolio balances across chains
list DeFi positions for an address
fetch transaction history for a wallet

apis.name: ZeroBounce
apis.tagline: Email validation and deliverability API for cleaning lists and verifying addresses
apis.description: ZeroBounce provides REST APIs for real-time and bulk email validation, email scoring, activity data, and related deliverability tools. Developers authenticate with an API key and call endpoints to check whether addresses are valid, catch-all, disposable, or toxic before sending.

auth.details: API key as query parameter api_key (and often in POST body for bulk); self-serve signup in dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 free credits on signup (no credit card required); credit-based free tier

apis.rate_limits: not published
use_cases: validate a single email address before signup
bulk-clean a CSV of marketing list emails
score email quality risk for a lead
detect disposable or toxic email addresses
check domain age and MX for deliverability

apis.name: Zillow Bridge API
apis.tagline: MLS and public-record property data via Zillow’s Bridge platform for licensed partners.
apis.description: Zillow Bridge (Bridge Data Output) provides licensed partners with MLS listing and public-record property data through a REST API. Access is partner-only; authentication and endpoints follow Bridge Data Output docs for property, listing, and assessment resources.

auth.details: API key via access_token query param or Authorization header; partner signup required (not fully self-serve).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Automatic access is limited to a synthetic test dataset. Production datasets require provider approval; Bridge charges no service fee, but MLS or data-provider licensing fees and conditions may apply.
pricing.paid_plans: Partner/commercial licensing; contact sales

apis.rate_limits: No general cap on total or concurrent API requests is published currently. Zillow Public Records has a default limit of 1,000 requests per day.
use_cases: fetch MLS listings for a market
look up property public records by address
sync listing status and price changes
query property assessments and tax data
